### help.topic_news_body
EN: # No in-app feed, by decision
This wallet ships no news feed: the reference UI pulled headlines from an external blog service, and bundling a hosted feed would break the day its owner moves it. No fetch is attempted, so there is no spinner and no fetch-error panel.
# Staying current instead
The connection line on the News page is always live, and project discussion happens in the linked community chats under Help.
IT: # Nessun feed in-app, per decisione
Questo wallet non include alcun feed di notizie: la UI di riferimento tirava titoli da un servizio blog esterno, e includere un feed ospitato si romperebbe il giorno in cui il proprietario lo sposta. Nessun fetch è tentato, quindi nessuno spinner e nessun pannello di errore fetch.
# Restare aggiornati invece
La riga di connessione nella pagina Notizie è sempre live, e la discussione del progetto avviene nelle chat comunitarie linkate in Aiuto.

### help.topic_news_text
EN: Why this wallet ships no in-app news feed.
IT: Perché questo wallet non include un feed di notizie in-app.

### help.topic_news_title
EN: News
IT: Notizie

### help.topic_password_body
EN: # Re-encrypt everything
Changing the password re-encrypts the whole local vault under a new passphrase: enter the current one, choose a unique replacement, and confirm.
# Verify before you walk away
Lock and unlock once with the new passphrase before funding anything — a typo here plus a lost brainkey means lost funds.
# Short or reused passwords fall to guessing; a unique passphrase written on paper does not.
IT: # Ricifri tutto
Cambiare la password ricifra l'intero vault locale sotto una nuova passphrase: inserisca quella attuale, scelga un sostituto unico e confermi.
# Verifichi prima di allontanarsi
Blocchi e sblocchi una volta con la nuova passphrase prima di finanziare qualsiasi cosa — un refuso qui più una brainkey persa significa fondi persi.
# Le password brevi o riusate cadono ai tentativi; una passphrase unica scritta su carta no.

### help.topic_password_text
EN: Re-encrypt the local vault with a new passphrase.
IT: Ricifri il vault locale con una nuova passphrase.

### help.topic_pmo_body
EN: # Branded prediction houses
A prediction market organization is a parent asset carrying a machine-readable charter: name, website, resolution policy, and dispute rules.
Sub-markets issue under it as dotted names (HOUSE.ELECTION2028), so holders can verify who stands behind a market before trusting its resolution.
# Creating and joining
Create an organization from the prediction page, then issue sub-markets beneath it. Long dotted names also pay the cheapest creation-fee tier.
Browsing organizations shows each house with its active and expired market counts — empty houses with no markets earn no trust.
IT: # Case di previsione brandizzate
Un'organizzazione di mercato di previsione è un asset genitore con charter leggibile dalla macchina: nome, sito, regole di risoluzione e di disputa.
I sotto-mercati emettono sotto di essa come nomi puntati (CASA.ELEZIONE2028), così i detentori possono verificare chi sta dietro un mercato prima di fidarsi della sua risoluzione.
# Creare e unirsi
Crei un'organizzazione dalla pagina previsioni, poi emetta sotto-mercati sotto di essa. I nomi puntati lunghi pagano anche lo scaglione di commissione di creazione più economico.
Sfogliare le organizzazioni mostra ciascuna casa con i conteggi di mercati attivi e scaduti — le case vuote senza mercati non guadagnano fiducia.

### help.topic_pmo_text
EN: Branded houses that issue prediction markets under one name.
IT: Case brandizzate che emettono mercati di previsione sotto un unico nome.

### help.topic_pmo_title
EN: Prediction organizations
IT: Organizzazioni di previsione

### help.topic_pools_body
EN: # Supply two assets, earn the flow
Liquidity pools hold pairs of assets and price swaps between them automatically. Suppliers deposit both sides and earn a cut of every swap fee, proportional to their share.
# Staking pool shares
Depositing mints share tokens tracking your slice. Stake them to earn, unstake to leave; updating fees or deleting an empty pool are owner actions with confirms.
# Impermanent reality
If prices drift apart after you deposit, withdrawing buys back less value than holding both assets would have. Fees must outrun that drift — check the pool's volume before committing size.
IT: # Fornisca due asset, guadagni dal flusso
Le pool di liquidità detengono coppie di asset e prezzano gli swap tra loro automaticamente. I fornitori depositano entrambi i lati e guadagnano una quota di ogni commissione di swap, in proporzione alla loro quota.
# Quote della pool in stake
Depositare conia token di quota che tracciano la Sua fetta. Li metta in stake per guadagnare, li tolga per uscire; aggiornare le commissioni o eliminare una pool vuota sono azioni del proprietario con conferme.
# Realtà impermanente
Se i prezzi divergono dopo il deposito, il prelievo riacquista meno valore che detenere entrambi gli asset. Le commissioni devono superare quella divergenza — controlli il volume della pool prima di impegnare size.

### help.topic_pools_text
EN: Supply two assets, earn a cut of every swap; stake pool shares.
IT: Fornisca due asset, guadagni una quota di ogni swap; metta in stake le quote della pool.

### help.topic_pools_title
EN: Liquidity pools
IT: Pool di liquidità

### help.topic_prediction_body
EN: # YES/NO shares on real outcomes
Prediction market assets are SmartCoins whose feed tracks a real-world condition — an election, a launch, a price level — stated in plain English with an expiry.
Buy YES by buying the asset; the feed price is the market's live probability. After expiry the issuer settles at 1.0 (happened) or 0.0 (didn't), and winners redeem collateral.
# Reading a market
The detail view shows condition, expiry, feed history, and the probability in four formats: implied percent, decimal, fractional, and American.
No price means no probability — the screen says so instead of inventing fifty percent.
# Positions and portfolio
Holdings show average cost against current price with unrealised profit and loss. Settle settled-market holdings for collateral; sell live ones back on the desk.
IT: # Quote SÌ/NO su esiti reali
Gli asset di mercato di previsione sono SmartCoin il cui feed segue una condizione reale — un'elezione, un lancio, un livello di prezzo — dichiarata in inglese semplice con scadenza.
Compri SÌ comprando l'asset; il prezzo del feed è la probabilità live del mercato. Dopo la scadenza l'erogatore regola a 1,0 (accaduto) o 0,0 (non accaduto) e i vincitori riscattano il collaterale.
# Leggere un mercato
La vista dettaglio mostra condizione, scadenza, cronologia feed e la probabilità in quattro formati: percentuale implicita, decimale, frazionaria e americana.
Nessun prezzo significa nessuna probabilità — lo schermo lo dice invece di inventare cinquanta percento.
# Posizioni e portafoglio
Le detenzioni mostrano costo medio contro prezzo corrente con profitti e perdite non realizzati. Regoli le detenzioni di mercati settled per il collaterale; rivenda quelle live sulla sezione.

### help.topic_prediction_text
EN: YES/NO shares on real-world outcomes with live probabilities.
IT: Quote SÌ/NO su esiti reali con probabilità live.

### help.topic_prediction_title
EN: Prediction markets
IT: Mercati di previsione

### help.topic_proposals_body
EN: # Pending multi-signature actions
Proposals wait for approvals or expiry: transfers, updates, and bundle wraps proposed by one party for others to sign.
Each shows proposer, expiry, review accounts, and the enclosed operations in human rows — approve only what you understand.
# Approve, reject, or let expire
Approval adds your signature toward the threshold; rejection is on the record; expiry deletes the proposal by itself.
Treat surprise proposals as hostile until proven otherwise.
IT: # Azioni multi-firma in attesa
Le proposte attendono approvazioni o scadenza: trasferimenti, aggiornamenti e pacchetti proposti da una parte perché altri firmino.
Ciascuna mostra proponente, scadenza, account di revisione e le operazioni incluse in righe umane — approvi solo ciò che comprende.
# Approvi, rifiuti o lasci scadere
L'approvazione aggiunge la Sua firma verso la soglia; il rifiuto resta agli atti; la scadenza elimina la proposta da sola.
Tratti le proposte a sorpresa come ostili fino a prova contraria.

### help.topic_proposals_title
EN: Proposals
IT: Proposte

### help.topic_referrals_body
EN: # Bring users, earn splits
Registering an account names a referrer and a registrar. Every fee that account ever pays splits three ways: network, referrer, registrar.
Your splits vest and settle per maintenance interval — recent earnings show pending until the round closes.
# Lifetime leverage
Lifetime members earn bigger splits plus cashback on their own fees. The account page shows your registrar's exact cut — no hidden beneficiaries.
IT: # Porti utenti, guadagni divisioni
Registrare un account nomina un referrer e un registrar. Ogni commissione mai pagata da quell'account si divide in tre: rete, referrer, registrar.
Le Sue divisioni maturano (vest) e si regolano per intervallo di manutenzione — i guadagni recenti risultano in attesa finché il round chiude.
# Leva lifetime
I membri lifetime guadagnano divisioni maggiori più cashback sulle proprie commissioni. La pagina account mostra il taglio esatto del Suo registrar — nessun beneficiario nascosto.

### help.topic_referrals_text
EN: How registration splits fees between referrer and registrar.
IT: Come la registrazione divide le commissioni tra referrer e registrar.

### help.topic_referrals_title
EN: Referrals
IT: Referral

### help.topic_register_body
EN: # Claim a name
Registration claims an on-chain account name through the faucet registrar: pick an unused name, fund the creation fee, and the registrar creates the account for you.
# Faucet reality
The testnet faucet answers reliably; the old European testnet faucet is dead and stays listed nowhere. On mainnet, creation goes through the registrar your settings name.
# After creation
Back up the new wallet before funding it — the brainkey IS the backup. Import existing keys instead under Import if the account already exists.
IT: # Richieda un nome
La registrazione richiede un nome account on-chain tramite il registrar faucet: scelga un nome inutilizzato, finanzi la commissione di creazione e il registrar crea l'account per Lei.
# Realtà faucet
Il faucet testnet risponde affidabilmente; il vecchio faucet testnet europeo è morto e non resta elencato da nessuna parte. Su mainnet, la creazione passa dal registrar nominato nelle Sue impostazioni.
# Dopo la creazione
Esegua il backup del nuovo wallet prima di finanziarlo — la brainkey È il backup. Importi invece chiavi esistenti in Importi se l'account esiste già.

### help.topic_register_text
EN: Claim a name through the faucet registrar.
IT: Richieda un nome tramite il registrar faucet.

### help.topic_register_title
EN: Creating an account
IT: Creazione di un account

### help.topic_samet_body
EN: # Pooled funds, same asset in and out
Same-T funds pool one asset from many suppliers. Borrowers draw against a fund and repay with interest; the chain enforces balances and schedules.
# Denomination discipline
Funds denominate in whole units (1M base): create, draw, and repay in the same asset, and mind the fund's limits before committing size.
# Same-transaction rule
Paired fund operations belong in one transaction: split legs can strand half a deal. The desk builds the pair together — review once, sign once.
IT: # Fondi comuni, stesso asset dentro e fuori
I fondi Same-T raccolgono un asset da molti fornitori. I borrower attingono a un fondo e rimborsano con interessi; la chain applica saldi e programmi.
# Disciplina di denominazione
I fondi denominano in unità intere (base 1M): crei, attinga e rimborsi nello stesso asset, e consideri i limiti del fondo prima di impegnare size.
# Regola della stessa transazione
Le operazioni di fondo appaiate appartengono a un'unica transazione: gambe divise possono incagliare mezzo deal. La sezione costruisce la coppia insieme — verifichi una volta, firmi una volta.

### help.topic_samet_text
EN: Pooled same-asset funds with draws and repayments.
IT: Fondi comuni dello stesso asset con prelievi e rimborsi.

### help.topic_samet_title
EN: Same-T Funds
IT: Fondi Same-T

### help.topic_settings_body
EN: # Nodes: pick by health, not habit
The node table probes every endpoint live: latency plus head age, witness participation, and irreversible lag, graded Good through Forked.
A fast-but-stale or forked node is labeled, never shown as healthy. Switch with one tap; the footer always shows where you are connected.
# Find more nodes
The opt-in discovery button searches public node lists and probes what it finds. It names the privacy cost up front, runs cancellable in the background, and only ever proposes candidates — nothing joins your list without your tap.
# Themes, language, housekeeping
Three themes, twelve languages, custom nodes with add and remove, plus wallet, password, and reset controls — all on this one page, all instant, no reload.
# Candle depth
The candle-count input sets how many candles charts fetch (default 2000). Deeper windows cost more history calls — raise it for research, lower it on slow connections.
IT: # Nodi: scelga per salute, non per abitudine
La tabella dei nodi sonda ogni endpoint dal vivo: latenza più età dell'head, partecipazione dei witness e ritardo irreversibile, valutati da Buono a Forked.
Un nodo veloce ma stantio o forked è etichettato, mai mostrato come sano. Cambi con un tocco; il piè di pagina mostra sempre dove è connesso.
# Trovi più nodi
Il pulsante di scoperta opt-in cerca liste pubbliche di nodi e sonda ciò che trova. Dichiara il costo privacy in anticipo, gira annullabile in background e propone solo candidati — nulla entra nella Sua lista senza il Suo tocco.
# Temi, lingua, pulizia
Tre temi, dodici lingue, nodi personalizzati con aggiunta e rimozione, più controlli di wallet, password e reset — tutto in quest'unica pagina, tutto istantaneo, senza ricaricare.
# Profondità candele
L'input del conteggio candele fissa quante candele i grafici recuperano (default 2000). Finestre più profonde costano più chiamate di cronologia — lo alzi per ricerca, lo abbassi su connessioni lente.

### help.topic_settings_text
EN: Pick API nodes by live health, switch themes and language.
IT: Scelga i nodi API per salute live, cambi tema e lingua.

### help.topic_settings_title
EN: Settings and nodes
IT: Impostazioni e nodi

### help.topic_spotlight_body
EN: # A showcase, not an exchange
Spotlight is the reference UI's showcase grid: tiles that point at wallet features (HTLC, Direct Debit) plus a recurring-orders helper. It moves no funds itself and carries no chain operation.
# Recurring orders helper
The helper places N limit orders NOW at stepped prices — one transaction per order, each with its own confirm. No scheduler runs in a static page: closing the page places nothing further.
IT: # Una vetrina, non un exchange
Spotlight è la griglia vetrina della UI di riferimento: riquadri che puntano a funzioni del wallet (HTLC, Addebito diretto) più un aiuto per ordini ricorrenti. Non muove fondi da sé e non porta alcuna operazione di chain.
# Aiuto ordini ricorrenti
L'aiuto piazza N ordini limite ORA a prezzi scalati — una transazione per ordine, ciascuno con la sua conferma. Nessuno scheduler gira in una pagina statica: chiudere la pagina non piazza nulla oltre.

### help.topic_spotlight_text
EN: Showcase tiles plus a recurring-orders helper.
IT: Riquadri vetrina più un aiuto per ordini ricorrenti.

### help.topic_tickets_body
EN: # Lock stake, grow weight
Vote-locked tickets convert stake plus time into voting weight: longer locks weigh more, and weight decays nothing until unlock.
Create a ticket from liquid stake, top it up, and claim it back when the lock ends.
# Where weight counts
Ticket weight feeds witness, committee, and worker votes through the normal slate — publish the slate to activate it.
IT: # Blocchi stake, cresca il peso
I ticket a voto bloccato convertono stake più tempo in peso di voto: lock più lunghi pesano di più e il peso non decade nulla fino allo sblocco.
Crei un ticket da stake liquido, lo ricarichi e lo riscuota quando il lock finisce.
# Dove conta il peso
Il peso del ticket alimenta i voti di witness, comitato e worker tramite la normale slate — pubblichi la slate per attivarlo.

### help.topic_tickets_text
EN: Lock stake for voting weight that grows with lock time.
IT: Blocchi stake per un peso di voto che cresce con la durata del lock.

### help.topic_tickets_title
EN: Vote-locked tickets
IT: Ticket a voto bloccato

### help.topic_topops_body
EN: # What the chain does most
Top operations counts real operation types across the last 200 blocks: transfers, orders, fills, votes — ranked with shares, plus a donut for the shape of chain activity.
Refresh re-runs the window. Testnet works here, unlike the old stats pages that were mainnet-only.
# Two desks, one count
Top Operations pairs the rankings with the activity donut; the Operations desk shows the same window as a plain ranked table. Both read the same blocks.
# Reading it
A healthy chain shows transfers and order flow on top with governance and maintenance underneath. Spikes in exotic types deserve a look in the explorer.
IT: # Cosa fa di più la chain
Le operazioni principali contano i tipi reali di operazione negli ultimi 200 blocchi: trasferimenti, ordini, esecuzioni, voti — classificati con quote, più una ciambella per la forma dell'attività di chain.
Aggiorni riesegue la finestra. Testnet funziona qui, a differenza delle vecchie pagine statistiche solo-mainnet.
# Due sezioni, un conteggio
Operazioni principali abbina le classifiche alla ciambella attività; la sezione Operazioni mostra la stessa finestra come semplice tabella classificata. Entrambe leggono gli stessi blocchi.
# Leggerlo
Una chain sana mostra trasferimenti e flusso ordini in cima con governance e manutenzione sotto. Picchi in tipi esotici meritano un'occhiata nell'explorer.

### help.topic_topops_text
EN: Which chain operations run hottest, counted from recent blocks.
IT: Quali operazioni della chain sono più frequenti, contate dai blocchi recenti.

### help.topic_topops_title
EN: Top operations
IT: Operazioni principali

### help.topic_tour_body
EN: # Five steps, then freedom
The first-run tour walks the dashboard, market strip, charts, trade panels, and beyond: where to look, what each part does, how to leave. Dismiss any time; it never blocks.
# Replay
Take tour replays from the dashboard whenever you want a refresher — same five steps, same dismiss.
IT: # Cinque passi, poi libertà
Il tour iniziale percorre dashboard, striscia mercati, grafici, pannelli di trading e oltre: dove guardare, cosa fa ciascuna parte, come uscire. Lo chiuda in qualsiasi momento; non blocca mai.
# Replica
Riproduca il tour dalla dashboard quando vuole un ripasso — stessi cinque passi, stessa chiusura.

### help.topic_tour_text
EN: The five-step first-run walkthrough; replay it any time.
IT: La procedura guidata iniziale in cinque passi; la riproduca in qualsiasi momento.

### help.topic_tour_title

### help.topic_transfer_body
EN: # Sending assets
Pick the asset, the recipient account, and the amount; the wallet adds the chain fee and shows the full confirm before you sign.
Double-check the name — chain transfers do not reverse.
# Encrypted memos
Attach a memo to transfer text privately: it encrypts to the recipient's memo key and only they can read it.
Leave the memo empty for a plain public transfer.
# Fees
Every transfer pays the chain fee from the fee schedule. The confirm dialog shows the exact fee before you sign — never estimate, never guess.
IT: # Invio di asset
Scelga l'asset, l'account destinatario e l'importo; il wallet aggiunge la commissione di chain e mostra la conferma completa prima che firmi.
Ricontrolli il nome — i trasferimenti della chain non si annullano.
# Memo cifrati
Alleghi un memo per trasferire testo in privato: si cifra sulla chiave memo del destinatario e solo lui può leggerlo.
Lasci il memo vuoto per un trasferimento pubblico semplice.
# Commissioni
Ogni trasferimento paga la commissione di chain dal tariffario. Il dialogo di conferma mostra la commissione esatta prima che firmi — mai stimare, mai tirare a indovinare.

### help.topic_translation-limitations_body
EN: A translation marked machine-filled was written by a machine. Nobody has read it to check that it says what the English says — which is why every language except English carries the marker chip in this wallet's header. English is the text the others were translated from, so it carries no marker.

# What the * on a line means
A * on a signing line means two things at once: the wording was filled by a machine, and the original English is one tap away. Tap the * and the English appears under the line exactly as this wallet's English master stores it — the same text every other language was translated from, not a paraphrase of it.

The marker follows the line, not the words inside it. A * marks one whole translated line, and the wallet picks those lines by a fixed rule: every line on a signing, irreversible-action or recovery screen — up to a length cap, since a long paragraph is covered by this article instead — plus any line anywhere whose English carries danger wording. So a line that only names an id or an amount still carries one (the To field on a transfer, for one), and a long paragraph that mentions an id does not. A bare chain value — an amount in a cell, an id in a column, an asset symbol — is not a translated line at all, so it never carries one: there is no English wording behind it to compare against.

# What the confidence levels mean
Every language this wallet ships carries one rating, listed in the table below. High means the wording tracks the English closely and reads naturally. Good means it is usable, though a phrase may still read awkwardly. Moderate means read it as a draft and check the English before you rely on it.

Every rating below is the machine that wrote the strings grading its own work; nobody independent has audited them. A rating describes what has been checked so far, for the language as a whole rather than line by line. English itself is the reference: it is written by hand, and every other language is translated from it.

# How to correct a string
Corrections start with a report. Say which language the line was in, give the key that line discloses, paste the English it was supposed to say, and suggest the wording you would use instead.

- One report per line keeps a fix easy to apply.
- Report the signing screens first: a wrong sentence on a confirm dialog is the costly kind.
- Use the link at the end of this article. It opens an issue already labelled for translations on this project's tracker, so nothing has to be retyped.

# Corrections are the only path to human reviewed
Nothing else moves a string off machine-filled: not how often a language is used, not a second machine agreeing with the first, not a translation memory. A string becomes human reviewed when a person reads it in its own language and accepts it, and a line is human reviewed only for the language that was actually checked.

Until then the marker stays where it is. A translation nobody has read beats no translation at all, but it is not the same thing as one a person stood behind.
IT: Una traduzione contrassegnata come scritta da una macchina è stata scritta da una macchina. Nessuno l'ha letta per verificare che dica ciò che dice l'inglese — per questo ogni lingua tranne l'inglese porta il contrassegno nell'intestazione di questo wallet. L'inglese è il testo da cui le altre sono state tradotte, quindi non porta nessun contrassegno.

# Cosa significa il * su una riga
Un * su una riga di firma significa due cose insieme: la formulazione è stata riempita da una macchina e l'inglese originale è a un tocco di distanza. Tocchi il * e l'inglese compare sotto la riga esattamente come lo memorizza il master inglese di questo wallet — lo stesso testo da cui ogni altra lingua è stata tradotta, non una parafrasi.

Il contrassegno segue la riga, non le parole contenute. Un * contraddistingue un'intera riga tradotta, e il wallet sceglie quelle righe secondo una regola fissa: ogni riga di una schermata di firma, di azione irreversibile o di recupero — fino a un limite di lunghezza, perché un paragrafo lungo è coperto da questo articolo invece — più qualsiasi riga, ovunque si trovi, il cui inglese contiene un avvertimento di pericolo. Quindi una riga che nomina solo un id o un importo ne porta comunque uno (per esempio il campo A di un trasferimento), mentre un paragrafo lungo che cita un id non lo porta. Un valore grezzo della chain — un importo in una cella, un id in una colonna, il simbolo di un asset — non è affatto una riga tradotta, quindi non ne porta mai: dietro non c'è alcuna formulazione inglese da confrontare.

# Cosa significano i livelli di affidabilità
Ogni lingua che questo wallet distribuisce ha una valutazione, elencata nella tabella qui sotto. Alta significa che la formulazione segue da vicino l'inglese e si legge naturalmente. Buona significa che è utilizzabile, anche se una frase può suonare ancora goffa. Media significa leggerla come bozza e controllare l'inglese prima di farvi affidamento.

Tutte le valutazioni qui sotto sono la macchina che ha scritto le strings che valuta il proprio lavoro; nessuno indipendente le ha verificate. Una valutazione descrive che cosa è stato controllato finora, per la lingua nel suo complesso e non riga per riga. L'inglese stesso è il riferimento: è scritto a mano e ogni altra lingua è tradotta da esso.

# Come correggere una stringa
Le correzioni cominciano da una segnalazione. Dica in quale lingua era la riga, fornisca la chiave che quella riga dichiara, incolli l'inglese che avrebbe dovuto dire e proponga la formulazione che userebbe al suo posto.

- Una segnalazione per riga rende la correzione facile da applicare.
- Segnali prima le schermate di firma: una frase sbagliata in un dialogo di conferma è il caso costoso.
- Usi il link in fondo a questo articolo. Apre una segnalazione già etichettata per le traduzioni nel tracker di questo progetto, quindi non c'è nulla da riscrivere.

# Le correzioni sono l'unica strada verso la revisione umana
Nient' altro porta una stringa fuori dallo stato « scritta da una macchina»: non quanto spesso una lingua viene usata, non una seconda macchina che concorda con la prima, non una memoria di traduzione. Una stringa diventa riletta da una persona quando qualcuno la legge nella propria lingua e la accetta, e una riga è riletta solo per la lingua che è stata davvero controllata.

Finché resta così, il contrassegno rimane dov'è. Una traduzione che nessuno ha letto è comunque meglio di nessuna traduzione, ma non è la stessa cosa di una che una persona ha sottoscritto.

### help.topic_translation-limitations_text
EN: Machine-filled translations are labeled; the English reference is always one tap away. Help us fix a line.
IT: Le traduzioni scritte da una macchina sono contrassegnate; il riferimento inglese è sempre a un tocco di distanza. Ci aiuti a correggere una riga.

### help.topic_trollbox_body
EN: # Public chat on-chain
Trollbox channels live on the blockchain itself: every message is a tiny paid transaction, which is exactly what keeps spam uneconomical.
Posting costs a fraction of a cent per kilobyte — reads are free and need no login.
# Channels and manners
Pick a channel, read first, then post. Messages are permanent and public to the whole world — never post secrets, keys, or personal data.
# Cost honesty
The composer shows the live fee before you sign. Long messages cost more kilobytes; split essays across posts.
IT: # Chat pubblica on-chain
I canali trollbox vivono sulla blockchain stessa: ogni messaggio è una minuscola transazione pagata, ed è esattamente ciò che rende lo spam antieconomico.
Pubblicare costa una frazione di centesimo per kilobyte — le letture sono gratis e non richiedono login.
# Canali e buone maniere
Scelga un canale, legga prima, poi pubblichi. I messaggi sono permanenti e pubblici al mondo intero — non pubblichi mai segreti, chiavi o dati personali.
# Onestà dei costi
Il compositore mostra la commissione live prima che firmi. I messaggi lunghi costano più kilobyte; divida i saggi su più post.

### help.topic_trollbox_text
EN: On-chain public chat rooms, paid per kilobyte like any transaction.
IT: Chat pubbliche on-chain, pagate per kilobyte come qualsiasi transazione.

### help.topic_trollbox_title
EN: Trollbox chat
IT: Chat trollbox

### help.topic_txbuilder_body
EN: # Several operations, one signature round
The builder composes multiple operations — transfers, votes, stakes — into a single transaction you review once and sign once.
Add from Transfer, Voting, or Pool stake screens, or queue manually; export and import envelopes to move drafts between sessions.
# Review before you sign
Every queued operation renders a human row with amounts in human terms. The fee preview covers the whole bundle with one chain fee call.
# Proposals from bundles
Wrap any bundle as a multi-signature proposal instead of sending it: proposers, expiry, and review accounts, all before signatures.
IT: # Più operazioni, un giro di firma
Il costruttore compone più operazioni — trasferimenti, voti, stake — in un'unica transazione: verifichi una volta e firmi una volta.
Aggiunga da Trasferimento, Voto o stake di Pool, oppure accodi manualmente; esporti e importi buste per spostare bozze tra sessioni.
# Verifichi prima di firmare
Ogni operazione in coda rende una riga umana con importi in termini umani. L'anteprima commissione copre l'intero pacchetto con un'unica chiamata commissione di chain.
# Proposte da pacchetti
Avvolga qualsiasi pacchetto come proposta multi-firma invece di inviarlo: proponenti, scadenza e account di revisione, tutto prima delle firme.

### help.topic_txbuilder_title
EN: Transaction builder
IT: Costruttore di transazioni

### help.topic_uris_body
EN: # Links that prefill payments
BitShares URIs (bitshares:…) pack a payment request — recipient, asset, amount, memo — into a shareable link. Opening one prefills the transfer or invoice form; only review and sign remain.
# Verify before signing
Links can lie about who they pay: check the recipient name yourself. The wallet never signs from a link alone.
# CSV history export
Account history exports to CoinTracking-compatible CSV for taxes and records. Amounts export as display decimals with symbols; dates stay empty rather than guessed.
IT: # Link che precompilano pagamenti
Gli URI BitShares (bitshares:…) impacchettano una richiesta di pagamento — destinatario, asset, importo, memo — in un link condivisibile. Aprirne uno precompila il modulo trasferimento o fattura; restano solo verifica e firma.
# Verifichi prima di firmare
I link possono mentire su chi pagano: controlli da sé il nome del destinatario. Il wallet non firma mai da solo link.
# Esportazione CSV della cronologia
La cronologia account si esporta in CSV compatibile CoinTracking per tasse e registri. Gli importi si esportano come decimali di visualizzazione con simboli; le date restano vuote piuttosto che indovinate.

### help.topic_uris_text
EN: BitShares links that prefill payments, plus CSV history export.
IT: Link BitShares che precompilano pagamenti, più esportazione CSV della cronologia.

### help.topic_uris_title
EN: Payment requests and exports
IT: Richieste di pagamento ed esportazioni

### help.topic_vesting_body
EN: # Locked now, yours later
Vesting balances release on schedule: worker pay, referral rewards, and large fees arrive over time instead of at once.
Each balance shows its schedule and claimable remainder; claiming is one transaction with one fee.
# Claim when due
Claimed funds land liquid immediately. Unclaimed schedules simply wait — nothing expires, nothing decays.
IT: # Bloccato ora, Suo dopo
I saldi vesting si liberano a programma: paghe worker, ricompense referral e grandi commissioni arrivano nel tempo invece che in una volta.
Ogni saldo mostra il suo programma e il residuo riscuotibile; riscuotere è un'unica transazione con un'unica commissione.
# Riscuota quando dovuto
I fondi riscossi atterrano subito liquidi. I programmi non riscossi attendono semplicemente — nulla scade, nulla decade.

### help.topic_vesting_text
EN: Time-locked balances that release on schedule; claim when due.
IT: Saldi bloccati nel tempo che si liberano a programma; li riscuota quando dovuti.

### help.topic_voting_body
EN: # Why your vote matters
Voting keeps BitShares secure and funded: it picks the block producers, the policy setters, and which worker projects get paid.
Your vote's weight follows the BTS you hold. If community mechanics are new to you, a proxy (below) is the recommended start.
# Proxy: delegate when unsure
A proxy is an account you trust to vote with your weight on your behalf — like electing a representative.
While a proxy is set, you cannot vote directly for witnesses, committee members, or workers. You can release the proxy any time and vote yourself. Remember to publish your changes.
# Witnesses
Witnesses build and sign blocks from validated transactions. Vote for as many as you like; each gets your full weight. Full detail lives in the Witnesses article.
# Committee
The committee sets chain policy: trading and transaction fees, block size and interval, cashback percentages, vesting periods, and similar parameters. Full detail lives in the Committee Members article.
# Workers and the budget
Workers are paid proposals climbing from proposed to active once they out-vote the refund worker, paid from a fixed daily budget first-come first-served by rank. Full detail lives in the Workers article.
IT: # Perché il Suo voto conta
Il voto mantiene BitShares sicura e finanziata: sceglie i produttori di blocchi, chi fissa le regole e quali progetti worker vengono pagati.
Il peso del Suo voto segue i BTS che detiene. Se la meccanica comunitaria Le è nuova, un proxy (sotto) è l'inizio consigliato.
# Proxy: deleghi quando è incerto
Un proxy è un account di cui si fida per votare con il Suo peso al Suo posto — come eleggere un rappresentante.
Mentre un proxy è impostato, non può votare direttamente per witness, membri del comitato o worker. Può revocare il proxy in qualsiasi momento e votare da sé. Ricordi di pubblicare le modifiche.
# Witness
I witness costruiscono e firmano i blocchi da transazioni convalidate. Voti per quanti ne vuole; ciascuno riceve il Suo intero peso. Il dettaglio completo è nell'articolo Witness.
# Comitato
Il comitato fissa le regole della chain: commissioni di trading e transazione, dimensione e intervallo dei blocchi, percentuali di cashback, periodi di vesting e parametri simili. Il dettaglio completo è nell'articolo Membri del comitato.
# Worker e budget
I worker sono proposte retribuite che da proposte diventano attive quando superano il worker di rimborso, pagate da un budget giornaliero fisso in ordine di rango. Il dettaglio completo è nell'articolo Worker.

### help.topic_voting_text
EN: Vote witnesses, committee, workers — or hand it to a proxy.
IT: Voti witness, comitato, worker — oppure deleghi a un proxy.

### help.topic_voting_title
EN: Voting
IT: Voto

### help.topic_wallets_body
EN: # A web app with a local vault
This application runs in your browser and talks to a chain node as its gateway to the network. Everything secret stays in your browser's local vault.
# No cloud login
This wallet has no username-and-password login: every wallet here is local to one browser. To use your account on a new browser or computer, start from the same brainkey — there are no credentials that open it from anywhere on their own.
# Local wallet
A local wallet is a database inside one specific browser. It will not follow you to another computer or browser unless you carry the brainkey over and import it.
See the Backups article before you rely on a local wallet for real funds.
# Password discipline
The password encrypts the vault. Short or reused passwords fall to guessing; a unique passphrase written on paper does not.
Changing the password re-encrypts everything — verify the current one first, then confirm the wallet still unlocks before you walk away.
IT: # Un'app web con un archivio locale
Questa applicazione gira nel Suo browser e parla con un nodo della chain, che fa da gateway verso la rete. Tutto ciò che è segreto resta nell'archivio locale del Suo browser.
# Nessun login cloud
Questo wallet non ha un login con nome utente e password: ogni wallet qui è locale a un solo browser. Per usare il Suo account su un browser o un computer nuovo, riparta dalla stessa brainkey — non esistono credenziali che lo aprono da sole ovunque esse vengano da.
# Wallet locale
Un wallet locale è un database dentro un browser specifico. Non la segue su un altro computer o browser a meno che non porti con sé la brainkey e non la importi.
Legga l'articolo Backup prima di fare affidamento su un wallet locale per fondi reali.
# Disciplina della password
La password cifra l'archivio. Password corte o riutilizzate cedono alla deducibilità; una passphrase unica annotata su carta no.
Cambiare la password ricifra tutto — verifichi prima quella attuale, poi confermi che il wallet si sblocchi ancora prima di andarsene.

### help.topic_wallets_title
EN: Wallets
IT: Wallet

### help.topic_witnesses_body
EN: # What witnesses do
Witnesses are the block producers of BitShares. They collect validated transactions, construct new blocks, and sign them so the network can trust the chain's history.
Their role parallels miners on other chains — except here the right to produce blocks comes from shareholder votes, not hashing power.
# How they are chosen
BTS holders vote for their preferred block producers on-chain under delegated proof of stake. The candidates with the most vote weight earn the producer slots.
You may vote for as many witnesses as you like, and each one receives your full vote weight — voting for more never dilutes your support.
# Voting well
Candidate statements and community discussion are the honest way to pick: look for reliable block production, honest price feeds, and steady maintenance.
If you do not want to research every candidate, set a proxy you trust instead of voting blind. Publish your changes so the chain records them.
# In this wallet
Browse producers, your current votes, and the proxy setting under Voting, and confirm any slate change before signing — votes are on-chain transactions with fees.
IT: # Cosa fanno i witness
I witness sono i produttori di blocchi di BitShares. Raccolgono transazioni convalidate, costruiscono nuovi blocchi e li firmano così la rete può fidarsi della storia della chain.
Il loro ruolo è analogo ai miner di altre chain — tranne che qui il diritto di produrre blocchi deriva dai voti degli azionisti, non dalla potenza di hash.
# Come sono scelti
I detentori di BTS votano on-chain i produttori di blocchi preferiti in delega di stake. I candidati con più peso di voto guadagnano gli slot di produzione.
Può votare per quanti witness vuole e ciascuno riceve il Suo intero peso di voto — votare per più candidati non diluisce mai il Suo sostegno.
# Votare bene
Dichiarazioni dei candidati e discussione della community sono il modo onesto per scegliere: cerchi produzione affidabile dei blocchi, feed di prezzo onesti e manutenzione costante.
Se non vuole studiare ogni candidato, imposti un proxy di cui si fida invece di votare alla cieca. Pubblichi le modifiche così la chain le registra.
# In questo wallet
Consulti produttori, voti attuali e l'impostazione proxy in Voto, e confermi ogni modifica della slate prima di firmare — i voti sono transazioni on-chain con commissioni.

### help.topic_witnesses_text
EN: Block producers that validate transactions and build blocks; vote for them or through a proxy.
IT: Produttori di blocchi che convalidano le transazioni e costruiscono i blocchi; voti per loro o tramite un proxy.

### help.topic_witnesses_title
EN: Witnesses

### help.topic_workers_body
EN: # Work paid by the chain
Workers are proposals to do something useful — development, marketing, infrastructure — in exchange for a salary paid by the blockchain itself.
Each proposal states at minimum a start and end date, a daily pay, a maximum total pay, and a link explaining the work. Check that link before voting.
# Lifecycle: proposed, active, expired
Proposed workers are collecting votes. Once a proposal out-votes the refund worker it becomes active and starts getting paid; if support drops below that bar it is defunded.
Expired proposals stay visible for history after their end date passes.
# How the budget works
All workers share one fixed daily budget, paid first-come first-served by vote rank: the top-voted proposals collect their daily pay until the budget runs out.
A proposal can be approved yet earn nothing if higher-ranked workers already consumed the day's funds — rank matters, not just approval.
# In this wallet
Read proposals, compare pay and dates, and cast or withdraw your votes under Voting. Publish your changes so the chain records them.
IT: # Lavoro pagato dalla chain
I worker sono proposte di fare qualcosa di utile — sviluppo, marketing, infrastruttura — in cambio di uno stipendio pagato dalla blockchain stessa.
Ogni proposta indica come minimo data di inizio e fine, paga giornaliera, paga totale massima e un link che spiega il lavoro. Controlli quel link prima di votare.
# Ciclo di vita: proposto, attivo, scaduto
I worker proposti raccolgono voti. Quando una proposta supera il worker di rimborso diventa attiva e inizia a essere pagata; se il sostegno scende sotto la soglia viene definanziata.
Le proposte scadute restano visibili per la cronologia dopo la data di fine.
# Come funziona il budget
Tutti i worker condividono un unico budget giornaliero fisso, pagato in ordine di rango di voto: le proposte più votate riscuotono la paga giornaliera finché il budget si esaurisce.
Una proposta può essere approvata ma non guadagnare nulla se i worker di rango superiore hanno già consumato i fondi del giorno — conta il rango, non solo l'approvazione.
# In questo wallet
Legga le proposte, confronti paghe e date ed esprima o ritiri i Suoi voti in Voto. Pubblichi le modifiche così la chain le registra.

### samet.same_asset_same_t_funds_borrowing_and_repayin
EN: Same-asset (Same-T) funds: borrowing and repaying happen in ONE transaction [67 borrow + 68 repay] — the chain rejects a lone borrow. Rates are percent at denom 1,000,000.

### seo.desc_account
EN: View this BitShares account — balances, orders and history read live from the chain. No login needed.
IT: Vedi questo account BitShares — saldi, ordini e storico letti live dalla chain. Nessun login richiesto.

### seo.desc_dashboard
EN: BitShares dashboard — balances, markets and chain activity at a glance. Browse freely; keys stay on your device.
IT: Dashboard BitShares — saldi, mercati e attività della chain a colpo d'occhio. Sfogli pure; le chiavi restano sul Suo dispositivo.

### seo.desc_explorer
EN: Explore BitShares blocks, transactions and assets — live chain data, browsable with no login.
IT: Esplori blocchi, transazioni e asset di BitShares — dati live della chain, sfogliabili senza login.

### seo.desc_help
EN: BitShares wallet help — guides for accounts, trading, voting and recovery. Start here when stuck.
IT: Aiuto del wallet BitShares — guide per account, trading, voto e recupero. Cominci da qui quando è bloccato.

### seo.desc_markets
EN: Browse BitShares order-book markets by 24h volume and open any pair's trading desk. No login needed.
IT: Sfogli i mercati del book ordini BitShares per volume 24h e apra la sezione di trading di qualsiasi coppia. Nessun login richiesto.

### seo.desc_pools
EN: Browse BitShares liquidity pools — pairs, balances and activity read live from the chain. No login needed.
IT: Sfogli le pool di liquidità BitShares — coppie, saldi e attività letti live dalla chain. Nessun login richiesto.

### seo.desc_xrates
EN: Every pool asset priced in BTS and more at last swap prices. No login needed.
IT: Ogni asset di pool quotato in BTS e oltre agli ultimi prezzi di swap. Nessun login richiesto.

### about.hero_lede
EN: A wallet for the BitShares blockchain — markets, accounts, governance, and exploration — running as plain web files. No framework, no installer, no account with us. Your keys never leave this browser.
JA: BitShares チェーンのためのウォレット — マーケット、アカウント、ガバナンス、探索 — を、プレーンな Web ファイルとして動かしています。フレームワークもインストーラーも、私たちへのアカウント登録もありません。鍵がこのブラウザから出ることはありません。

### about.making_body
EN: What follows is the original build story: every prompt that created this wallet, from "acquire bitshares-ui" on 26 September 2026 to the issue-1 fix on 3 October, with the builders' replies — preserved unedited. It records the decisions this wallet stands on: walking away from another React uplift after issue #3583 and its thousand-hour trap, so this wallet depends on nothing with a release cycle; signing every transaction locally like the old wallet instead of outsourcing it; three themes with the classic look as default; numbers in human terms, never raw chain integers; phone-first layouts from the first slice; and fees read from the live chain, never estimated. Read it as history: this is how the wallet got built.
JA: 以下は当初の開発記録です — このウォレットを作ったすべてのプロンプトを、2026年9月26日の「acquire bitshares-ui」から10月3日の issue 1 の修正まで、構築者たちの返信とともに編集せずに残しています。このウォレットが立つ基盤となる判断が記録されています: issue #3583 とその1000時間の罠のあとに React の別のアップグレードを断念し、リリースサイクルを持つ何にも依存しないようにしたこと。すべてのトランザクションを古いウォレットと同じくローカルで署名し、外部に委ねなかったこと。クラシックな外観を既定とする3つのテーマ。数は常に人間表示にし、生の整数は表示しないこと。最初のスライスからスマートフォン優先のレイアウトにしたこと。手数料は推定せず、ライブチェーンから読むこと。歴史として読んでください — このウォレットはそうやって作られました。

### about.making_title
EN: Making of this wallet
JA: このウォレットの開発の記録

### about.s1_body
EN: Accounts live in an encrypted vault on your device, and every transaction is signed locally before broadcast. The nodes you connect to never see your secrets — which is also why backups are yours alone: lose the brainkey and nobody can recover your funds.
JA: アカウントはデバイス上の暗号化された保管庫にあり、すべてのトランザクションはブロードキャスト前にローカルで署名されます。接続先ノードがあなたの秘密を見ることは決してありません — だからこそバックアップはあなた自身の責任です。ブレインキーを失くすと誰にも資金を取り戻せません。

### about.s1_title
EN: Your keys never leave this browser
JA: あなたの鍵がこのブラウザから出ることはありません

### about.s2_body
EN: Order books, liquidity pools, swaps, borrowing, credit, prediction markets, and voting all settle on-chain. What you see is the chain itself — books you can trade against, not pictures of books.
JA: オーダーブック、流動性プール、スワップ、借入、クレジット、予測マーケット、投票はすべてチェーン上で決済されます。あなたが見ているのはチェーンそのものです — 取引できるオーダーブックであり、オーダーブックの画像ではありません。

### about.s2_title
EN: Trade on the real order book
JA: 本物のオーダーブックで取引

### about.s3_body
EN: The wallet it replaces died under a hundred stale packages and a toolchain nobody can reproduce. Built to avoid release-cycle dependencies: no framework, no package manager, no build step — the smallest thing that can still run in a browser a decade from now.
JA: このウォレットが置き換える側のウォレットは、古いパッケージと誰も再現できないツールチェーンのもとで停止しました。リリースサイクルへの依存を避けるために作られています: フレームワークなし、パッケージマネージャーなし、ビルド手順なし — 10年後もブラウザで動く最小構成です。

### about.s3_title
EN: Runs for years with no updates
JA: 更新なしで長く動き続けます

### about.s4_body
EN: Returning users feel at home instantly — the same pages, panels, and words as the classic wallet — while balances, books, and connection status update live in place. Forgiving search across markets, accounts, and assets, three themes, and layouts that work from a 360px phone to a 4K trading desk.
JA: 戻ってきたユーザーはすぐに馴染めます — クラシックなウォレットと同じページ、同じパネル、同じ語彙 — 此同时、残高、オーダーブック、接続状態はそのままライブ更新されます。マーケット、アカウント、アセットを横断して検索でき、3つのテーマと、360px のスマートフォンから4Kの取引デスクまで使えるレイアウトです。

### about.s4_title
EN: Same pages, live updates
JA: 同じページ、ライブ更新

### about.s5_body
EN: The chain speaks integers; you never see them. Every amount sits at its asset's decimals, every percent at its true value, and every fee is read from the live chain before you sign.
JA: チェーンは整数で話します。あなたが見ることはありません。すべての金額はアセットの精度どおりに置かれ、すべてのパーセントは正しい値で示され、すべての手数料は署名の前にライブチェーンから読み取ります。

### about.s5_title
EN: Numbers you can trust
JA: 信頼できる数値

### about.s6_body
EN: Gateways are custodians holding your outside coins — read their terms as the custody deal it is. The history index is run by the community, not by this wallet. Some features have no testnet data by nature, and there is no in-app news feed by decision. Where this wallet cannot know, it says so instead of guessing.
JA: ゲートウェイは外部コインを預かるカストディアンです — その条件をカストディ契約として読んでください。履歴インデックスはコミュニティが運営し、このウォレットによるものではありません。一部機能は性質上テストネットデータがなく、アプリ内ニュースフィードは方針としてありません。このウォレットが知り得ない箇所では、推測せずその旨を明示します。

### about.s6_title
EN: Honest limits
JA: 正直な制限

### apilab.gate_body

JA: このページは手作りのAPI呼び出しを公開ノードに送り、生のチェーンJSONを表示します。読み取りは安全です。ブロードキャストでは実際の資金が動きます。内容を理解している場合のみ進んでください。

### apilab.gate_broadcast
EN: Broadcasting sends a REAL signed transaction on the connected chain. Only proceed if you built and reviewed the transaction yourself and you know which chain (mainnet or testnet) you are on.
JA: ブロードキャストでは接続中のチェーン上で実際の署名済みトランザクションが送信されます。トランザクションを自分で構築・確認し、どのチェーン（メインネットかテストネットか）にいるか把握している場合のみ進んでください。

### apilab.gate_debug

JA: デバッグやノード保守の呼び出しは公開APIノードでは通常無効です。拒否されることを想定してください — 拒否は正直な結果であり、このページの不具合ではありません。

### help.topic_about-making_body
EN: # Making of this wallet
What follows is the original build story: every prompt that created this wallet, from "acquire bitshares-ui" on 26 September 2026 to the issue-1 fix on 3 October, with the builders' replies — preserved unedited.
It records the decisions this wallet stands on: walking away from another React uplift after issue #3583 and its thousand-hour trap, so this wallet depends on nothing with a release cycle; signing every transaction locally like the old wallet instead of outsourcing it; three themes with the classic look as default; numbers in human terms, never raw chain integers; phone-first layouts from the first slice; and fees read from the live chain, never estimated. Read it as history: this is how the wallet got built.
# The full dialog archive
The complete exchange-by-exchange record lives on the About page (#/about). Expand the "Full build dialog" section there to browse all exchanges, filter by keyword, or deep-link to a specific exchange with ?dialog=N.
JA: # このウォレットの開発の記録
以下は当初の開発記録です — このウォレットを作ったすべてのプロンプトを、2026年9月26日の「acquire bitshares-ui」から10月3日の issue 1 の修正まで、構築者たちの返信とともに編集せずに残しています。
このウォレットが立つ基盤となる判断が記録されています: issue #3583 とその1000時間の罠のあとに React の別のアップグレードを断念し、リリースサイクルを持つ何にも依存しないようにしたこと。すべてのトランザクションを古いウォレットと同じくローカルで署名し、外部に委ねなかったこと。クラシックな外観を既定とする3つのテーマ。数は常に人間表示にし、生の整数は表示しないこと。最初のスライスからスマートフォン優先のレイアウトにしたこと。手数料は推定せず、ライブチェーンから読むこと。歴史として読んでください — このウォレットはそうやって作られました。
# 開発対話の全記録
やり取りを1件ずつ完全に記録したものは About ページ（#/about）にあります。あそこの「開発対話の全記録」を開くと、すべてのやり取りを閲覧でき、キーワードで絞り込め、?dialog=N で特定のやり取りへ直接ジャンプできます。

### help.topic_about-making_text
EN: The build story behind this wallet —
JA: このウォレットを作った記録 —

### help.topic_about-making_title
EN: Making of this wallet
JA: このウォレットの開発の記録

### help.topic_accounts-general_body
EN: # One name, one account
On this chain you register a human-readable account name first, then use it everywhere instead of pasting raw addresses.
Owning the name and being able to spend its funds are separate rights, which is what makes shared and corporate accounts possible — see Permissions.
# What lives on an account
Balances across every asset you hold, your open exchange orders, and your full transaction history all hang off the account.
# In this wallet
Open any account overview to see its balances, open orders, and history with no login — reads are public on a public chain.
Only spending needs your keys: cancelling someone else's order is refused, and your own cancels ask you to unlock first.
JA: # 1つの名前、1つのアカウント
このチェーンでは先に人間の読めるアカウント名を登録し、以降は生アドレスの貼り付けの代わりにどこでも使います。
名前の所有と資金の使用は別の権利です。これにより共有・法人アカウントが可能になります — 権限の記事をご覧ください。
# アカウントにあるもの
保有するすべてのアセットの残高、オープンの取引所注文、すべてのトランザクション履歴がアカウントに紐付きます。
# このウォレットでは
アカウント概要を開くと、ログインなしで残高、オープン注文、履歴が表示されます — 公開チェーンでは閲覧は公開です。
支出にのみキーが必要です。他人の注文の取消は拒否され、ご自身の取消は先にアンロックを求められます。

### help.topic_accounts-general_text
EN: One name, one on-chain account: balances, orders and history.
JA: 1つの名前、1つのオンチェーンアカウント: 残高、注文、履歴。

### help.topic_accounts-general_title
EN: Accounts
JA: アカウント

### help.topic_accounts-membership_body
EN: # Three tiers
Every account starts as a regular non-member. Upgrading buys lifetime status; an annual subscription sits in between for smaller budgets.
Upgrading is an on-chain action with a fee from the published fee schedule — the confirm dialog shows the exact price before you sign.
# Why go lifetime
Lifetime members earn cashback on every transaction fee they pay, plus referral income from users they bring to the network.
# Where fee money goes
Each fee you pay is split: the network takes its cut, the lifetime member who referred you takes theirs, and the registrar divides the remainder with its affiliate program.
# Pending and vesting fees
Referral splits settle once per maintenance interval, not instantly. Large fees, such as membership upgrades, vest over the committee-defined period.
JA: # 3つの会員階層
すべてのアカウントは通常の非会員から始まります。アップグレードでライフタイム会員になります。中間には小規模向けの年額プランがあります。
アップグレードは公開手数料表に基づくオンチェーン操作です — 確認ダイアログに正確な価格が署名前に表示されます。
# ライフタイムの利点
ライフタイム会員は支払うすべての取引手数料のキャッシュバックに加え、紹介したユーザからの紹介収入を得られます。
# 手数料の行方
支払う各手数料は分割されます。ネットワークが取り分を取り、紹介したライフタイム会員が取り分を取り、レジストラが残りをアフィリエイトプログラムと分けます。
# 保留・ベスティング手数料
紹介分配はメンテナンス間隔ごとに決済され、即時ではありません。会員アップグレード等の大型手数料は委員会定義期間でベスティングされます。

### help.topic_accounts-membership_text
EN: Basic vs lifetime membership tiers and what changes.
JA: ベーシック会員とライフタイム会員の階層の違いと変更点。

### help.topic_accounts-membership_title
EN: Memberships
JA: 会員資格

### help.topic_accounts-permissions_body
EN: # Two locks: active and owner
Active permission controls the money — spending, trading, transferring. Owner permission controls the account itself and can overwrite keys and settings.
Both are edited in your account's Permissions tab as authorities plus a threshold: the summed weight of the signers must beat the threshold for a transaction to count.
# Authorities, weights, thresholds
An authority names one or more accounts (or keys), each with a weight. Signatures add up their weights; cross the threshold and the action is authorized.
This one mechanism expresses everything from a single key to corporate hierarchies.
# Example: shared funds, any two of four
Give four partners weight 33 each with threshold 51: any two together pass, no single one can move funds alone.
# Example: one stays in charge
Give the lead 49 and each friend a smaller slice with threshold 51: the lead plus any one friend can act, or all friends together — theft by one friend alone is impossible.
# The memo key
The memo key only receives encrypted memos — it can never spend. Because it carries no spending power, you may share its private key with a reader (auditor, accountant) for read-only memo access without risking funds.
JA: # 2つの鍵: アクティブとオーナー
アクティブ権限は資金を管理します — 支出、取引、送金。オーナー権限はアカウント自体を管理し、キーや設定を上書きできます。
どちらもアカウントの権限タブで権限としきい値として編集します。署名者の重みの合計がしきい値を超えるとトランザクションが有効になります。
# 権限、重み、しきい値
権限は1つ以上のアカウント（またはキー）を重み付きで指定します。署名は重みを合算し、しきい値を超えると操作が承認されます。
単一キーから企業階層まで、この1つの仕組みで表現できます。
# 例: 4人中2人の共有資金
4人のパートナーに各重み33、しきい値51を与えます。2人一緒で可決し、1人単独では資金を動かせません。
# 例: 代表者が主導権を保持
代表に49、友人各々に小さな割合を与え、しきい値51とします。代表＋友人1人で実行でき、全友人一緒でも実行できます — 友人1人単独の窃取は不可能です。
# メモキー
メモキーは暗号化メモの受信専用であり、支出はできません。支出権限がないため、秘密キーを読者（監査人、会計士）と共有し、資金リスクなしに読取専用メモ閲覧が可能です。

### help.topic_accounts-permissions_title
EN: Permissions
JA: 権限

### help.topic_accounts-proposed_body
EN: # Suggest what you cannot sign
A proposal submits a transaction for someone else's approval: you suggest an action on an account you do not control, and the controlling parties approve or ignore it.
The classic case is a shared multi-signature account — one party proposes a transfer, the others approve until the authority threshold is met, and then it executes.
# They expire on their own
Every proposal carries an expiry date. Past that date it disappears by itself, so a stale suggestion cannot surprise anyone months later.
# Treat surprises as hostile
An unexpected proposal on your account deserves suspicion, not curiosity — even if the proposer's name looks familiar.
When in doubt, ignore it and contact the supposed counterparty through a channel you already trust. Never approve what you do not understand.
# In this wallet
Review pending proposals and approve or reject them from the proposals screens; the confirm dialog shows exactly what the proposal would do before you sign.
JA: # 署名できないものを提案する
提案は他人承認用のトランザクションを提出します。管理していないアカウントへの操作を提案し、管理者が承認または無視します。
典型例は共有マルチシグアカウントです — 一人が送金を提案し、権限のしきい値を満たすまで他の承認者が承認すると実行されます。
# 期限切れは自動です
各提案には有効期限があります。期限を過ぎると自動で消滅するため、古い提案が数か月後に不意に実行されることはありません。
# 不意の提案は敵対的に扱います
身に覚えのない提案は、好奇心ではなく疑いで扱ってください — 提案者名が見覚えがあっても同様です。
疑わしい場合は無視し、既知の連絡手段で相手に直接確認してください。理解できないものは承認しないでください。
# このウォレットでは
保留中の提案を確認し、提案画面で承認または却下します。確認ダイアログには提案の内容が署名前に正確に表示されます。

### help.topic_accounts-proposed_title
EN: Proposed transactions
JA: 提案中のトランザクション

### help.topic_airdrop_body
EN: # One plan, many recipients
Airdrops distribute an asset to a list of accounts in a single planned operation instead of hundreds of manual transfers.
Build the recipient list, preview totals, confirm once — the chain fans the payments out.
# Mind the dust
Tiny outputs can cost more in fees than they deliver. Preview per-recipient net amounts and drop dust lines before signing.
JA: # 1プラン、多数受取人
エアドロップは数百の手動送金の代わりに単一計画操作でアセットを受取人一覧に分配します。
受取人一覧を作成し、合計をプレビューし、一度確認します — チェーンが支払いを分配します。
# 粉塵に注意
微小出力は手数料が受取額を上回る場合があります。受取人ごとの正味額をプレビューし、署名前に粉塵行を削除してください。

### help.topic_airdrop_text
EN: Distribute an asset to many accounts in one plan.
JA: 1つのプランで多くのアカウントにアセットを配布します。

### help.topic_airdrop_title
EN: Airdrops
JA: エアドロップ

### help.topic_alerts_body
EN: # Never watch a screen again
Price alerts watch markets while you live your life: set a price, pick above or below, get notified when the market crosses it.
Notifications stay off by default — each rule opts in explicitly, and rules die with one tap.
# Rules that respect you
Alerts evaluate on ticker refreshes, never on your keystrokes. No account needed to create one; signing is never involved — alerts only read.
JA: # 画面監視はもう不要
価格アラートは生活中にマーケットを監視します。価格を設定し、上下を選ぶと、マーケットのクロスで通知されます。
通知は既定オフです — 各ルールは明示的なオプトインで、1タップで消滅します。
# 尊重するルール
アラートはティッカー更新で評価され、キー入力では評価されません。作成にアカウント不要、署名なし — アラートは読取のみです。

### help.topic_alerts_text
EN: Get notified when a market crosses a price you set.
JA: マーケットが設定価格を超えたら通知を受け取ります。

### help.topic_alerts_title
EN: Price alerts
JA: 価格アラート

### help.topic_api-lab_body
EN: # A 29-call node prober
API Lab catalogs the calls this wallet actually uses — account and asset lookups, market data, fees, block reads — with forms for parameters and raw JSON results.
# Reads run free, broadcasts cost
Read-only calls execute against the connected node immediately. Anything that would broadcast names its fee before signing, same as every other desk.
# When a call fails
Failures name the cause (offline node, history-less node, bad parameter) and link back to Settings. Switch nodes from the node table and re-run.
JA: # 29コールノード調査
APIラボはウォレット実使用コールをカタログ化します — アカウント・アセット照会、マーケットデータ、手数料、ブロック読取 — パラメータ用フォームと生JSON結果付き。
# 読取は無料、ブロードキャストは有料
読取専用コールは接続ノードに即時実行されます。ブロードキャストを伴うものは他画面同様署名前に手数料を示します。
# 失敗時
失敗は原因（オフラインノード、履歴なしノード、不正パラメータ）を特定し設定へリンクします。ノード表からノードを切替えて再実行してください。

### help.topic_assets-mpa_body
EN: # Dollars without a bank
A market-pegged asset tracks an outside price — BitUSD, BitEUR, BitGOLD and friends — through contracts enforced by the chain itself.
Each unit stays backed by 100 percent or more of its value in BTS collateral, convertible at any time. Holders call them SmartCoins.
# No counterparty to fail you
Unlike an exchange IOU, a SmartCoin needs no issuer promise: the protocol locks the collateral and performs settlements automatically.
# How the peg holds
Borrowers lock BTS to create SmartCoins; witnesses publish the real-world price feeds the chain enforces against.
If collateral thins, margin calls close the weakest positions first; any holder can also force-settle at a fair price.
# In this wallet
Trade SmartCoins on any market desk, borrow them against BTS collateral under Borrow, and inspect supply, feeds, and settlement data in the asset and explorer screens.
JA: # 銀行なしのドル
市場連動アセットは外部価格に連動します — BitUSD、BitEUR、BitGOLD等 — チェーン自体が強制する契約によります。
各単位はBTS担保により価値の100%以上で裏付けられ、いつでも転換可能です。保有者はこれをスマートコインと呼びます。
# 破綻する相手方なし
取引所IOUと異なり、スマートコインに発行者の約束は不要です。プロトコルが担保をロックし、決済を自動実行します。
# ペッグの維持
借り手はBTSをロックしてスマートコインを作成します。ウィットネスはチェーンが強制する実勢価格フィードを公開します。
担保が薄くなると、担保比率が最低のポジションからマージンコールでクローズされます。保有者はいつでも公正価格で強制決済できます。
# このウォレットでは
スマートコインは任意のマーケット画面で取引し、借入画面でBTS担保に対して借り入れ、アセット・エクスプローラー画面で供給量、フィード、決済データを確認します。

### help.topic_assets-mpa_text
EN: Smartcoins backed by collateral with price feeds from witnesses.
JA: ウィットネスの価格フィードに裏付けられた担保付きスマートコイン。

### help.topic_assets-mpa_title
EN: Market-pegged assets
JA: 市場連動アセット

### help.topic_assets-private_body
EN: # Pegged assets, private feeds
A privatized BitAsset works like a market-pegged asset, except the issuer — not the witnesses — chooses who may publish its price feeds.
The issuer also sets the asset's fees and earns from them.
# Who wants this
Exchanges and institutions with real-time price access use privatized assets to quote their own markets without waiting on witness feeds.
# What it means for you
You trade the issuer's price, not the witnesses': check who publishes feeds and what the fee schedule is before holding a privatized asset.
JA: # 連動アセット、私的フィード
プライベートBitAssetは市場連動アセット同様に動作しますが、価格フィードの公開者は発行者が選びます — ウィットネスではなく —。
発行者はアセットの手数料も設定し、そこから収益を得ます。
# 想定利用者
リアルタイム価格にアクセスできる取引所や機関は、ウィットネスフィードを待たずに独自マーケットを提示するためプライベートアセットを使います。
# お客様への意味
ウィットネスではなく発行者の価格で取引します。保有前にフィード公開者と手数料表を確認してください。

### help.topic_assets-private_text
EN: Issuer-controlled assets with restricted transfer lists.
JA: 制限付き移転リストを持つ発行者管理アセット。

### help.topic_assets-private_title
EN: Privatized BitAssets
JA: プライベートBitAsset

### help.topic_assets-uia_body
EN: # Your token in minutes
Anyone — person or company — can create a user-issued asset for anything imaginable: event tickets, crowdfunding shares, ownership records, even company equity.
# Powerful, so handle with care
The issuer defines the rules: supply, precision, fees, transfer restrictions. A UIA is only as trustworthy as its issuer and its on-chain description.
Regulations differ by place and by token kind; issuers must stay compliant where they operate, and holders should read the asset details before buying.
# In this wallet
Create and manage your own tokens under Assets, and inspect any token's issuer, supply, and permissions before you trade or accept it.
JA: # 数分で作るあなたのトークン
誰でも — 個人でも企業でも — 想像できるあらゆる用途のユーザ発行アセットを作成できます。イベントチケット、クラウドファンディング持分、所有記録、企業株式も可能です。
# 強力だからこそ慎重に
発行者はルールを定義します。供給量、精度、手数料、移転制限。UIAの信頼性は発行者とオンチェーン説明次第です。
規制は地域とトークン種別で異なります。発行者は事業地域で準拠し、保有者は購入前にアセット詳細を読む必要があります。
# このウォレットでは
アセット画面で独自トークンを作成・管理し、取引・受領前に発行者、供給量、権限を必ず確認してください。

### help.topic_assets-uia_text
EN: Anyone can issue a custom token; create and manage them under Assets.
JA: 誰でもカスタムトークンを発行できます。アセット画面で作成・管理します。

### help.topic_assets-uia_title
EN: User-issued assets
JA: ユーザ発行アセット

### help.topic_authorities_body
EN: # Beyond owner, active, memo
Custom authorities define new permission sets — named roles with their own keys, weights, and thresholds for specific operation families.
Create them for treasuries, bots, and shared desks that should sign some things but never everything.
# Keep the map readable
Name each authority for its job, record thresholds beside the keys that meet them, and review the map yearly — stale authorities are attack surface.
JA: # オーナー、アクティブ、メモを超えて
カスタム権限は新しい権限セットを定義します — 特定操作ファミリー用の独自キー、重み、しきい値を持つ名前付き役割。
金庫、ボット、共有デスク用に作成します。一部署名可だが全部は不可とすべきものに。
# 対応表を読みやすく保つ
各権限は職務名を付け、満たすキー横にしきい値を記録し、年次見直ししてください — 陳腐な権限は攻撃面です。

### help.topic_authorities_title
EN: Authorities
JA: 権限

### help.topic_backups_body
EN: # Back up early, back up twice
Make a backup of your local wallet before you fund it — one backup is usually enough going forward, but keep it in at least two secure places only you can reach.
There is no backup file in this wallet: your brainkey IS the backup, and the passphrase alone restores nothing. Without both the words AND the passphrase your funds are gone. Never store the passphrase next to the words.
# Your brainkey is the backup
If you never imported raw keys by hand, your whole wallet derives deterministically from one brainkey — a string of words. Writing down the brainkey backs up every account and fund in that wallet.
View it in the wallet manager and copy it to paper, stored separately from anything digital. Reference-wallet .bin files cannot be imported here — the wallet says so on screen, and no file download exists.
# Advanced: hierarchical authorities
If you use weighted multi-account authorities instead of plain keys, a key backup alone may NOT restore access — the authority structure itself matters.
Re-read the Permissions article and record the full authority setup, not just the words.
JA: # 早めにバックアップ、2か所へ
ローカルウォレットに資金を入れる前にバックアップを取ってください — その後の運用は1つのバックアップで通常は十分ですが、自分だけがアクセスできる安全な場所に少なくとも2つ保存してください。
このウォレットにバックアップファイルはありません: ブレインキーこそがバックアップで、パスフレーズだけでは何も復元できません。単語とパスフレーズの両方がなければ資金は失われます。パスフレーズを単語のそばに決して保管しないでください。
# ブレインキーがバックアップです
生の鍵を手で取り込んだことがない場合、ウォレット全体は1つのブレインキー（単語の列）から決定的に導出されます。ブレインキーを書き留めれば、そのウォレットのすべてのアカウントと資金がバックアップされます。
ウォレット管理画面で表示して紙に写し、デジタルなものとは別に保管します。参照ウォレットの .bin ファイルはここでは取り込めません — ウォレットはそれを画面に表示し、ダウンロードするファイルも存在しません。
# 上級: 階層的な権限
通常の鍵の代わりに重み付けされた複数アカウントの権限を使っている場合、鍵のバックアップだけではアクセスを復元できないことがあります — 権限の構造そのものが重要です。
権限の記事を読み直し、単語だけでなく権限の設定全体を記録してください。

### help.topic_barter_body
EN: # Propose a straight swap
Barter proposes an asset-for-asset trade to a counterparty: you offer an amount of one asset and ask an amount of another, with an expiry.
# They approve or it lapses
The proposal executes when the counterparty approves, and deletes itself past expiry. Treat surprise barters as hostile until proven otherwise.
# In this wallet
Build the offer under Barter; the confirm dialog shows both legs in human terms before you sign.
JA: # 直接交換を提案
バーターは相手方にアセット間取引を提案します。1アセットの数量を提供し他アセットの数量を求め、期限付き。
# 承認か失効か
提案は相手方承認で実行され、期限後は自動削除されます。不意のバーターは証明まで敵対的に扱ってください。
# このウォレットでは
バーター画面で申出を作成します。確認ダイアログは署名前に両脚を人間表示で示します。

### help.topic_barter_text
EN: Propose direct asset-for-asset trades for approval.
JA: 承認式の直接的なアセット間取引を提案します。

### help.topic_barter_title
EN: Barter
JA: バーター

### help.topic_bitshares_body
EN: # The delegated-proof-of-stake exchange
BitShares is a delegated-proof-of-stake blockchain with a built-in exchange: order matching happens in the protocol itself, so trading needs no central company holding your funds.
It extends the blockchain idea beyond money — banking, exchanges, voting, auctions and more — run as distributed companies under public, auditable rules instead of human management.
# What it enables
On one chain you get user-issued assets, market-pegged assets, non-fungible tokens, the order-book exchange, pooled automated markets, and hashed time-lock contracts.
This wallet exposes most of those features: smartcoins, custom tokens, and the market desk are the places to start.
# Your keys never leave the browser
This is a browser wallet. Your keys are stored locally and transactions are signed locally before broadcast — the servers you connect to never see your secrets.
That is also why backups are your job alone: lose the brainkey or password and nobody can recover your funds.
# Design goals
- No custody: traders keep their own private keys and funds at all times.
- Blocks every few seconds; every operation lists its chain fee before you sign.
JA: # 高速分散取引所
BitSharesは組込取引所を持つ委任型プルーフオブステークブロックチェーンです。注文マッチングはプロトコル自体で行われるため、資金を預かる中央企業なしに取引できます。
ブロックチェーンの発想を通貨の枠を超えて拡張します — 銀行、取引所、投票、競売等 — 人管理の代わりに公開監査可能規則下の分散企業として運営。
# 可能にすること
1チェーンでユーザ発行アセット、市場連動アセット、非代替トークン、板取引所、プール自動マーケット、ハッシュタイムロックコントラクトを得られます。
このウォレットは大半を公開します。スマートコイン、カスタムトークン、マーケット画面が開始点です。
# キーはブラウザを離れません
これはブラウザウォレットです。キーはローカル保存されトランザクションはブロードキャスト前にローカル署名されます — 接続ノードは秘密を見ません。
だからこそバックアップはお客様単独の仕事です。ブレインキーやパスワードを紛失すると誰も資金を取り戻せません。
# 設計目標
- 非寄託: 取引者は常に自秘密キー・資金を保持。
- 高性能・低コスト： 小手数料で高速承認、各注文が証明可能に公正処理される透明マッチング。

### help.topic_bitshares_title
EN: What is BitShares
JA: BitSharesとは

### help.topic_blockchain_body
EN: # A public chain of blocks
Like most cryptocurrencies, BitShares records transfers and market activity in blocks, each pointing at the previous one — a chain holding every transaction ever made.
The ledger is public and auditable: anyone can verify transfers, orders, and order books. This wallet's explorer is built for exactly that.
# Who builds the blocks
Block producers are chosen by delegated proof of stake: BTS holders vote for preferred producers, called witnesses, and the top-voted ones may produce blocks.
Every transaction must validate against the witnesses' work, so voting is how holders keep the chain honest. See the Voting and Witnesses articles.
# More than transfers
The chain offers many transaction types beyond sending assets: exchange orders, borrowing, proposals, vesting, pools, and more.
Most types are self-explanatory in the confirm dialog; the deeper ones each have their own help article here.
JA: # ブロックの公開チェーン
多くの暗号通貨同様、BitSharesは送金・マーケット活動をブロックに記録し、各ブロックは前のブロックを指します — 史上すべてのトランザクションを保持するチェーン。
台帳は公開監査可能です。誰でも送金、注文、板を検証できます。このウォレットのエクスプローラーはまさにそのためにあります。
# ブロック作成者
ブロック生成者は委任型プルーフオブステークで選ばれます。BTS保有者は希望生成者（ウィットネス）に投票し、上位者がブロック生成できます。
各トランザクションはウィットネスの作業に照らして検証される必要があり、投票は保有者がチェーンを正直に保つ方法です。投票・ウィットネス記事をご覧ください。
# 送金だけではない
チェーンは送金以外にも多くの取引種別を提供します。取引所注文、借入、提案、ベスティング、プール等。
大半は確認ダイアログで自明です。深いものは各々ヘルプ記事があります。

EN: Blocks, transactions and objects, browsable in the explorer.
JA: ブロック、トランザクション、オブジェクトをエクスプローラーで閲覧できます。

### help.topic_blockchain_title
EN: Blockchain
JA: ブロックチェーン

### help.topic_borrow-extra_body
EN: # Force-settle smartcoins
Any SmartCoin holder may force-settle at a fair feed-derived price. The lowest-collateral shorts fund it first.
Settlement carries a fee and a delay — the confirm shows both before you sign.
# Collateral ratios, live
The borrow screens show each position's ratio against maintenance in real time. Top up or repay before the call price reaches you.
# Settlement bids
After global settlement events, collateral goes to bid. Bids commit funds at your price; winners settle, losers release automatically.
JA: # スマートコインを強制決済
スマートコイン保有者はフィード由来の公正価格で強制決済できます。担保比率が最低のショートから資金に充てられます。
決済には手数料と遅延があります — 確認ダイアログに署名前に両方が表示されます。
# 担保比率、ライブ
借入画面は各ポジションの比率をメンテナンス対比でリアルタイム表示します。コール価格到達前に追加または返済してください。
# 決済入札
全体決済イベント後、担保は入札に回ります。入札は価格を指定して資金を拘束します。落札は決済、不落は自動解放されます。

### help.topic_borrow-extra_text
EN: Force-settle smartcoins and watch collateral ratios and bids.
JA: スマートコインを強制決済し、担保比率と入札を監視します。

### help.topic_borrow-extra_title
EN: Settling and collateral
JA: 決済と担保

### help.topic_browser_body
EN: # Detected features, never brand names
This wallet never asks which browser you use — it probes the four platform features it genuinely needs: WebSocket (chain data), WebCrypto (keystore), BigInt (money math), and local storage (settings). Silence is a pass: no banner on a modern browser means everything is present.
# The most common cause: insecure context
Modern browsers expose WebCrypto only in secure contexts: https pages, localhost, and opened files. The same up-to-date browser served over plain http (for example a LAN address) reports WebCrypto missing — the browser is fine, the address is not. Serve the folder over https or localhost, or open index.html directly.
# What still works
Browsing always works: balances, markets, explorer, and voting read public chain data with no wallet features. Only local signing needs the missing piece. Dismissing the notice hides it on this machine; it never blocks a page.
JA: # ブランド名ではなく機能を検出します
このウォレットは使用したブラウザを尋ねません — 実際に必要な4つのプラットフォーム機能を検出します: WebSocket（チェーンデータ）、WebCrypto（キーストア）、BigInt（金額の計算）、ローカルストレージ（設定）。表示されないことは合格です: 新しいブラウザにバナーが出ないのは、すべてが揃っているということです。
# 最も多い原因: セキュアコンテキストではない
新しいブラウザはセキュアコンテキストでのみ WebCrypto を提供します: https のページ、localhost、そして開いたファイルです。同じ新しいブラウザでも、http で配信すると（たとえば LAN アドレス）、WebCrypto なしと判定されます — ブラウザの問題ではなく、アドレスの問題です。フォルダを https または localhost で配信するか、index.html を直接開いてください。
# それでも動く部分
閲覧は常にできます: 残高、マーケット、エクスプローラー、投票は、ウォレット機能を使わずに公開のチェーンデータを読みます。必要なのはローカルの署名だけです。通知を閉じるとこのマシンでは非表示になりますが、ページがブロックされることはありません。

### help.topic_browser_text
EN: Which browsers run the wallet, and what the compatibility notice means.
JA: 動作するブラウザと、互換性に関する通知の意味。

### help.topic_browser_title
EN: Browser support
JA: ブラウザ対応

### help.topic_charts_body
EN: # Price, depth, and oscillators
The desk shows a price pane (candles plus moving averages) with stacked oscillator sub-panes on independent scales, a volume pane, and a cumulative depth chart beside the book.
# Real candles, carried forward
Candles come from chain history with timeframe-aware interpolation: gaps carry the last price forward and flag red/green, so thin markets never invent volume.
# A 25-indicator catalog
Trend, momentum, volatility, and volume math (SMA through Fisher and PSAR) ships as dependency-free formulas verified against published vectors. Pick them from the indicator menu; parameters stay on their published defaults unless you change them.
JA: # 価格、板、オシレーター
画面は価格ペイン（ローソク足＋移動平均）に独立スケールのオシレーターサブペインを重ね、出来高ペイン、板横に累積デプスチャートを表示します。
# 実ローソク足、最終価格で補完
ローソク足はチェーン履歴由来で時間枠対応の補間付きです。空白期間は最終価格を引き継いで赤／緑で表示し、薄いマーケットで出来高を捏造しません。
# 25指標カタログ
トレンド、モメンタム、ボラティリティ、出来高計算（SMAからFisher・PSARまで）を依存なし式で公開ベクター検証済みとして同梱します。指標メニューから選択します。パラメータは変更しない限り公開既定値です。

### help.topic_charts_text
EN: Candles, depth, and the 25-indicator catalog on the desk.
JA: 画面上のローソク足、板、25指標カタログ。

### help.topic_charts_title
EN: Charts and indicators
JA: チャートと指標

### help.topic_committee_body
EN: # What the committee decides
Committee members are elected by shareholders to set chain policy: transaction and trading fees, block size and block interval, referral rewards, cashback percentages, vesting periods, and similar parameters.
It is a position of real responsibility — a bad parameter can raise everyone's costs or slow the chain, so it demands a working understanding of BitShares.
# How members are chosen
Like witnesses, committee members win their seats through shareholder votes, and holders may back as many candidates as they like or delegate to a proxy.
If the mechanics feel unfamiliar, a proxy is safer than a random ballot. Publish your changes so the chain records them.
# In this wallet
Review candidates and your current ballot under Voting, and confirm any slate change before signing — votes are on-chain transactions with fees.
JA: # 委員会が決めること
委員会メンバーは株主に選出されチェーンポリシーを設定します。取引・送金手数料、ブロックサイズ・間隔、紹介報酬、キャッシュバック率、ベスティング期間等。
実責ある地位です — 悪いパラメータは全員の費用を上げ、チェーンを遅くします。BitSharesの実務理解が求められます。
# 選出方法
ウィットネス同様、委員会メンバーは株主投票で議席を得ます。保有者は多数候補を支持でき、プロキシ委任も可能です。
仕組みが不慣れなら無作為投票よりプロキシが安全です。変更を公開してチェーンに記録してください。
# このウォレットでは
投票画面で候補と現在の票を確認し、署名前にスレート変更を確認してください — 投票は手数料付きオンチェーントランザクションです。

### help.topic_credit_body
EN: # Lend on your terms
Credit offers publish an asset, an interest rate, and limits. Borrowers draw against an offer and repay with interest; the chain enforces the deal.
# Borrowers: know the cost
Interest accrues per the offer terms from draw to repay. Repay early to stop the clock; the confirm shows principal plus accrued interest.
# Deals, not promises
Each draw opens a deal with its own balance and schedule. Track open deals under Credit and close them by repaying in full.
JA: # 条件を指定して貸出す
クレジットオファーはアセット、金利、制限を公開します。借り手はオファーから借入し、金利付きで返済します。チェーンがディールを強制します。
# 借り手: コストを把握
利息は借入から返済までオファー条件で発生します。早期返済で計時は止まります。確認ダイアログに元本＋発生済み利息が表示されます。
# 約束ではなくディール
各借入は独自残高・スケジュールのディールを開きます。クレジット画面でオープンディールを追跡し、全額返済でクローズします。

While locked, the home page is a landing: the project motto, a live market strip, the chain pulse, feature cards, and the steps to start. Nothing here needs your keys.
# Unlocked: your watched account
Unlock and the same page becomes your overview: balances, recent activity, favourite markets, and quick links for the wallet's own account.
# Starred markets strip
The above-fold strip mixes starred and featured quotes — star pairs from any market picker to make the tape yours.
JA: # ロック中: スプラッシュ

# アンロック: ウォッチアカウント
アンロックすると同ページが概要になります。残高、直近アクティビティ、お気に入りマーケット、ウォレット固有アカウントのクイックリンク。
# スターストリップ
ファーストビューストリップはスター付きと注目のクォートの混合です — 任意のマーケット選択からペアをスターしてテープをご自身用にしてください。

### help.topic_dex-intro_body
EN: # Exchange without the exchange company
The DEX trades digital goods directly on-chain: nobody holds your coins between order and fill.
One global book serves everyone with internet access, around the clock — there is no single server to fail and no opening bell.
# Trade almost anything
The protocol is asset-agnostic: any pair can trade, from USD against EUR down to long-tail pairs with thin liquidity.
# Secured by your keys, settled on-chain
Funds and orders are guarded by industry-grade elliptic-curve cryptography; multi-signature setups from the Permissions article work here too.
Orders settle on-chain, in blocks a few seconds apart — the matching rules are public and re-checkable.
# Matching you can verify
Given a set of orders, anyone can re-check that they were matched correctly: the matching algorithm is public and provable, not a black box on a server.
# Smartcoins complete the picture
BitUSD, BitEUR, BitCNY and siblings trade at their tracked values, each backed by locked BTS collateral redeemable through settlement.
JA: # 取引所会社なしの取引所
DEXはデジタル商品を直接オンチェーンで取引します。注文から約定までコインを預かる者はいません。
1つのグローバル板がインターネット接続のある全員に24時間稼働し続けます — 故障する単一サーバも開場ベルもありません。
# ほぼ何でも取引
プロトコルはアセット非依存です。USD対EURから流動性の薄いニッチなペアまで任意のペアが取引できます。
# 安全で高速
資金と注文は業界標準の楕円曲線暗号で保護されます。権限記事のマルチシグ構成もここで使えます。
このDEXはリアルタイムに約定します — 制限は物理と地球の大きさだけです。
# 検証可能なマッチング
注文セットが与えられれば、誰でも正しくマッチングされたか再確認できます。マッチングアルゴリズムは公開・証明可能であり、サーバ上のブラックボックスではありません。
# スマートコインが完成させます
BitUSD、BitEUR、BitCNY等は連動値を取引し、各々ロックBTS担保に裏付けられ決済で償還できます。
