### help.topic_direct-debit_body
EN: # Authorize pulls, then manage them
Direct debit lets an account authorize another to withdraw up to a limit on a schedule. Givers and recipients each see their side in tables.
# Create, update, claim, delete
Permissions carry periods and limits; claims draw against them, updates change the terms, and deletion is a free cancel. Claim memos are plaintext — never put secrets in one.
# Reads are public
Tables render even while locked (viewing as committee-account); the password is asked only at Sign & Send.
ZH: # 授权扣款，再管理
直接扣款让账户授权另一账户按期扣至上限。付出与接收双方各表可查。
# 创建、更新、领取、删除
授权带周期与限额；领取按授权提款，更新改条款，删除免费取消。领取备注是明文——绝不放秘密。
# 读取公开
表格锁定也渲染（以 committee-account 身份查看）；密码仅在“签名并发送”时要。

### help.topic_direct-debit_title
EN: Direct Debit
ZH: 直接扣款

### help.topic_disclaimer_body
EN: # What this wallet is
This wallet is an interface to the BitShares blockchain. Information you see here — balances, orders, markets — is created by blockchain users, not by this app.
Your keys are stored locally in your browser and never leave it: transactions are signed locally before they are broadcast. Never expose your keys to anyone.
# Not advice of any kind
Nothing here is legal, business, or investment advice. You act at your own risk when you rely on anything shown by this wallet.
If a decision matters, talk to a licensed professional in your jurisdiction.
# Where your risk sits
Most losses fall into a few buckets: your own mistakes (forgotten password, funds sent to the wrong name, deleted wallet data), broken software or malware on your machine, failed hardware, someone getting into your wallet, or a third-party service failing you.
Back up before funding anything, and treat every address and memo you paste as guilty until checked.
# Assets live on the chain, not here
This app does not store, send, receive, or hold any asset. Assets exist only as ownership records on the BitShares blockchain; every transfer happens on that decentralized ledger, not inside this page.
# Investment and tax reality
BitShares holdings can lose money over short or long periods, with large price swings. Nothing shown here promises otherwise.
You alone work out which taxes apply to your transactions.
# No warranties, limited liability
This wallet is provided as-is, at your own risk. To the extent the law allows, its owners and contributors are not liable for any damages from using it — including lost use, lost profits, or lost data.
ZH: # 本钱包是什么
本钱包是 BitShares 区块链的操作界面。您在此看到的信息——余额、订单、市场——均由区块链用户产生，而非本应用产生。
您的密钥保存在本地浏览器中，从不外传：交易先在本地签名再广播。请勿向任何人泄露密钥。
# 不构成任何建议
此处内容不构成法律、商业或投资建议。您依据本钱包所示内容行事，风险自担。
如需做重要决定，请咨询您所在司法管辖区的持牌专业人士。
# 您的风险所在
多数损失不出几类：您自己的失误（忘记密码、转错名称、删除钱包数据）、本机软件故障或恶意软件、硬件故障、他人侵入您的钱包，或第三方服务故障。
注资前请备份，并将粘贴的每个地址和备注都先视为可疑，直至核验无误。
# 资产在链上，不在这里
本应用不存储、发送、接收或托管任何资产。资产仅作为 BitShares 区块链上的所有权记录存在；每次划转都发生在去中心化账本上，而非本页面内。
# 投资与税务现实
BitShares 持仓短期或长期都可能亏损，价格波动剧烈。此处展示内容不做反向承诺。
哪些税适用于您的交易，请自行确认。
# 无担保，有限责任
本钱包按现状提供，风险自担。在法律允许范围内，其所有者与贡献者对使用造成的任何损害不承担责任——包括使用损失、利润损失或数据损失。

### help.topic_es-lab_body
EN: # The community index, browsable
ES Lab searches the third-party community index (es.bitshares.dev): operations by account or type, block ranges, transaction lookup by hash, and top asset holders — the things no public node serves.
# Gated and honest
The lab runs only while the community-index switch in Settings is on, and says so when it is off. Holders and hash lookup cover mainnet only — on testnet those desks explain the data gap instead of guessing.
# Curated forms plus raw console
Every catalog search shows the exact query it runs; the raw console accepts arbitrary bodies against the allowlisted indexes for power users.
ZH: # 社区索引，可逛
ES Lab 搜索第三方社区索引 (es.bitshares.dev)：按账户或类型查操作、区块区间、按哈希查交易、资产大户——公开节点不给的都在此。
# 有门且诚实
实验室仅在设置社区索引开关开时运行，关则明说。大户与哈希查只覆主网——测试网对应操作台解释数据缺口，而不猜测。
# 精选表单加原始控制台
目录中每次搜索都展示其运行的确切查询；原始控制台接受高阶用户的任意请求体，仅限白名单索引。

ZH: 以精选表单搜索社区历史索引。

ZH: ES 实验室

### help.topic_favourites_body
EN: # Pin what you touch daily
Star markets, assets, and accounts to pin them on the dashboard strip and pickers.
Favourites live per wallet profile and survive reloads; unstar with the same tap.
# The dashboard strip
Starred plus featured quotes form the above-fold market strip — your tape, your pairs, live prices without opening the desk.
ZH: # 置顶常用的
星标市场、资产与账户，置顶到总览条与选择器。
收藏按钱包档案存放，重载仍在；再次点击即取消星标。
# 总览条
星标加精选报价组成首屏市场条——您的行情，您的交易对，不开操作台看实时价。

### help.topic_fees_body
EN: # Every operation has a price
The chain charges per operation from a published fee schedule: transfers, orders, creations, votes — each with a flat core fee, some plus data-size surcharges.
This wallet previews the exact fee from the live chain before every signature — never estimated, never guessed.
# Who pays, in what
The signer pays, in the asset the form names (usually the core asset). Fee pools let some assets pay their own way; the fee-asset line names the payer.
# Creation tiers
Asset creation prices by symbol length: short premium names cost most, long dotted names least. The create form names the tier beside the live fee.
ZH: # 每操作皆有价
链按公布费率表按操作收费：划转、订单、创建、投票——各有核心固定费，若干加数据大小附加。
本钱包每次签名前从实时链预览确切手续费——从不估算，从不猜测。
# 谁付，用什么
签名人付，表单写明资产（通常核心资产）。手续费池让部分资产自付其路；手续费资产行写明付款人。
# 创建档
资产创建按符号长度定价：短靓名最贵，带点长名最便宜。创建表单在实时手续费旁写明档位。

### help.topic_fees_text
EN: What each operation costs and which asset pays it.
ZH: 每操作多少钱，谁出，用哪资产。

### help.topic_fees_title
EN: Network fees
ZH: 网络手续费

### help.topic_gateways-ioxbank_body
EN: # Instant swaps to IOU tokens
The IOXBank gateway bridges outside coins onto BitShares with immediate settlement after outside-chain confirmation. Its tokens wear the IOB. prefix — IOB.XRP and IOB.XLM among them.
# Reserves you can check
IOXBank publishes its outside-chain reserve addresses, so you can compare its XRP and XLM balances against the IOB.XRP and IOB.XLM supplies visible in this wallet's asset screens.
# Depositing from the wallet
Choose the coin on the deposit desk: you receive the gateway address plus the tag or memo to include, and you must repeat that reference at the source of your outside transfer.
# Withdrawing manually
To withdraw by hand, send your IOB.* tokens to the ioxbank-gateway account with a memo naming the coin, destination address, and tag: xrp:ADDRESS:tag:NUMBER, or xlm: first for Stellar.
Replace every placeholder with your own values and double-check the address — outside chains rarely forgive typos.
# Limits and support
Minimums are small (single-digit XRP, tens of XLM) — below them, deposits may not credit.
ZH: # 即时兑换为 IOU 代币
IOXBank 网关把外部币桥上 BitShares，外部链确认后即时到账。其代币带 IOB. 前缀——IOB.XRP 与 IOB.XLM 位列其中。
# 可查的储备
IOXBank 公布外部链储备地址，您可将其 XRP 与 XLM 余额，同本钱包资产页可见的 IOB.XRP 与 IOB.XLM 供应量对照。
# 在钱包中充值
在充值操作台选币：拿到网关地址与须附的标签或备注，务必在外部划转源头重复该参考信息。
# 手动提现
手工提现，把 IOB.* 代币发到 ioxbank-gateway 账户，备注写明币种、目的地址与标签，格式为 xrp:ADDRESS:tag:NUMBER（Stellar 则以 xlm: 开头）。
请把每个占位替换为自己的值并复核地址——外部链极少原谅笔误。
# 限额与客服
下限很小（个位数 XRP，数十 XLM）——低于下限，充值可能不到账。

### help.topic_gateways-ioxbank_text

ZH: IOXBank 网关操作台及支持的币种。

### help.topic_gateways-ioxbank_title

ZH: IOXBank 网关

### help.topic_gateways-xbts_body
EN: # What XBTS is
XBTS runs a gateway service on the BitShares exchange, moving popular cryptocurrencies in and out. Every supported coin carries the XBTSX. prefix, such as XBTSX.BTC.
Its site and live support chat are the places for status, terms, and incident help — this wallet only drives its desks.
# Depositing
Pick the coin on the deposit desk to get the gateway's address (and tag or memo where needed), then send from the outside chain including every reference shown.
Credit needs outside-chain confirmations first.
# Withdrawing and fallback
Withdraw from the desk with your destination address; the wallet prefills the transfer and the gateway's memo format for you.
If automation is down, the same desk documents the manual path: send the XBTSX.* token to the gateway account with the memo format shown, exactly as written.
ZH: # XBTS 是什么
XBTS 在 BitShares 交易所经营网关服务，进出流行加密货币。每种支持币都带 XBTSX. 前缀，如 XBTSX.BTC。
其站点与在线客服是状态、条款与事故求助之地——本钱包只驱动其操作台。
# 充值
在充值操作台选币，拿到网关地址（需要处还有标签或备注），再从外部链发送，并带上所示全部参考信息。
到账须先等外部链确认。
# 提现与备用
在操作台提现，填目的地址；钱包为您预填划转与网关备注格式。
自动化宕机时，同页记录手动路径：按所示备注格式把 XBTSX.* 代币发到网关账户，一字不差。

### help.topic_gateways-xbts_text
EN: XBTS bridge desk with supported coins and manual fallback.
ZH: XBTS 网关操作台及支持的币种，附手动备用通道。

### help.topic_gateways-xbts_title
EN: XBTS gateway
ZH: XBTS 网关

### help.topic_gateways_body
EN: # Coins from other chains
Gateways and bridges are outside companies that carry assets onto BitShares: you send them BTC (or fiat, or XRP...), they hand you a matching token on this chain, redeemable back for a fee.
While you hold their token, THEY hold your original coins — read their terms as the custody deal it is.
# Bridges: trust minimized
A bridge swaps your deposit for a SmartCoin equivalent, so after the short transfer window you hold collateral-backed tokens with no custodian risk.
# Gateways: trust required
A gateway issues its own branded IOUs, each backed by the real coins users deposited with that operator.
Like any exchange balance, those tokens are worth exactly as much as the operator's solvency and honesty. Prefer gateways with transparent reserves and a support channel that answers.
# In this wallet
Deposit and withdraw through the bridge screens in this app; each coin's desk shows addresses, memos, limits, and a manual fallback when automation is down.
Withdrawals leave as normal transfers with the gateway's memo format — copy it exactly, because the operator's software parses it.
ZH: # 来自其他链的币
网关与桥是把资产搬上 BitShares 的外部公司：您给它们 BTC（或法币、或 XRP……），它们给您链上对应代币，可赎回，收手续费。
持有其代币期间，原币在它们手里——请把其条款当作托管协议来读。
# 桥：信任最小化
桥用存款换智能币等价物，短暂划转窗口过后，您持有无托管风险的抵押支撑代币。
# 网关：须信任
网关发行自有品牌欠条，各自由存入该运营商的真币支撑。
如任何交易所余额，那些代币的价值恰等于运营商的偿付与诚实。优先选储备透明、有客服应答的网关。
# 在本钱包中
在本应用桥接页面充值提现；每币种操作台展示地址、备注、限额，自动化宕机时有手动备用。
提现是带网关备注格式的普通划转——请一字不差复制，运营商软件靠它解析。

### help.topic_gateways_title
EN: Gateways
ZH: 网关

### help.topic_glossary_body
EN: # Objects: everything has an id
Accounts, assets, orders, proposals, witnesses — nearly everything on-chain is an object with an id like 1.2.0 (the leading digits say which space it lives in).
In this wallet, account ids look like 1.2.x and asset ids like 1.3.x; pasting an id into the explorer opens that object directly.
# Operations: what transactions do
Transactions carry operations numbered 0-77: transfers, orders, votes, pool moves, tickets, chat. The explorer names each op it shows.
# People and roles
Witnesses produce blocks; committee members set chain parameters; workers deliver paid projects; proxies vote on your behalf; the registrar is whoever paid to create your account.
# Money words
Precision is how many decimals an asset uses — amounts are stored as integers and shifted by it, so the wallet always shows human decimals, never raw integers.
Collateral backs borrowed SmartCoins; margin calls and settlements close weak positions; fees on every operation split between the network, referrers, and registrars.
ZH: # 对象：万物皆有 ID
账户、资产、订单、提案、见证人——链上几乎万物皆对象，ID 如 1.2.0（开头数字说其住哪个空间）。
在本钱包，账户 ID 如 1.2.x，资产 ID 如 1.3.x；粘贴 ID 到浏览器直达该对象。
# 操作：交易在做什么
交易携带编号 0-77 的操作：划转、订单、投票、资金池动作、票证、聊天。浏览器为所见每操作具名。
# 人与角色
见证人生产区块；理事会成员定链参数；工人交付有偿项目；代理代您投票；注册商是花钱为您建账户的人。
# 钱的话
精度是资产用的小数位数——金额以整数存储，按精度折算，钱包永远展示日常小数，绝不展示原始整数。
抵押物支撑借出的智能币；保证金追缴与结算关闭弱仓位；每操作手续费在网络、推荐人与注册商之间切分。

EN: Names used across this wallet: objects (1.x.y), operations, witnesses, committee.
ZH: 本钱包通用名称：对象 (1.x.y)、操作、见证人、理事会。

### help.topic_glossary_title
EN: Glossary
ZH: 术语表

### help.topic_history-index_body
EN: # Two histories, two jobs
Node history comes from the public API node you picked: account activity, fills, market candles, settlement and order reads. The Settings table marks every node with a History pill from a live probe — pick a History node for history features.
The community index is a third-party ElasticSearch (es.bitshares.dev) that adds what no node serves: top asset holders, transaction lookup by hash, and deeper archives. It is run by the community, not by this wallet — questions go to t.me/bitsharesDEV.
# When something is missing
A panel that needs history you don't have says so and links back to Settings: switch to a History node, or turn the community index on. Nothing here ever shows a blank panel or a guessed number.
# Testnet limits
Node history works on testnet, but the community index covers mainnet only — index-powered features (holders, hash lookup) are unavailable on testnet by data, not by bug.
# The switch
Settings holds the community-index toggle (on by default). Turn it off and every index surface falls back to chain history or an honest notice — your call, reversible any time.
# Browsing the index
The ES Lab desk turns the index into searchable forms plus a raw console: operations by account or type, holders, and hash lookup, each showing the exact query it runs.
ZH: # 两份历史，两种活
节点历史来自您选的公开 API 节点：账户动态、成交、市场 K 线、结算与订单读取。设置表为每节点打历史标签，凭实时探测——使用历史功能请选择历史节点。
社区索引是第三方 ElasticSearch (es.bitshares.dev)，补节点不给的：资产大户、按哈希查交易、更深档案。它由社区运营，非本钱包——问题去 t.me/bitsharesDEV。
# 缺东西时
需要您没有的历史，面板明说并链回设置：换历史节点，或打开社区索引。此处绝无空白面板与猜测数字。
# 测试网限制
节点历史测试网可用，社区索引只覆主网——索引功能（大户、哈希查）在测试网因数据缺席，并非故障。
# 开关
设置存社区索引开关（默认开）。关闭后，每个索引功能都回退到链历史或显示诚实提示——您说了算，随时可逆。
# 逛索引
ES Lab 操作台把索引变成可搜表单加原始控制台：按账户或类型查操作、大户、哈希查，每条展示所跑的确切查询。

EN: Node history vs the community index: what works where, and how to reconcile gaps.
ZH: 节点历史与社区索引：哪里管什么，如何对齐缺口。

### help.topic_history-index_title
EN: Community history index
ZH: 社区历史索引

### help.topic_htlc_body
EN: # Trustless swaps across time
A hash time-locked contract locks funds behind two conditions: reveal a secret hash preimage, or wait out the timelock for a refund.
Two parties lock both sides with the same hash — either both legs complete or both refund. No escrow agent, no trust.
# Create, redeem, refund
Create with the hash, the counterparty, and an expiry comfortably past the other leg. Redeem by revealing the preimage before expiry; after expiry the funder reclaims.
Watch expiries on both chains involved — a missed window strands funds until refund.
ZH: # 跨时间的无信任兑换
哈希时间锁定合约把资金锁在两个条件后：揭示秘密哈希原像，或等时间锁到期退款。
双方用同一哈希锁住两边——要么两边同成，要么同退。无需托管，无需信任。
# 创建、赎回、退款
创建时给出哈希、对手方，以及晚于另一边、留有余量的到期时间。在到期前揭示原像即可赎回；到期后出资方收回。
盯紧两条链的到期——错过窗口，资金将一直锁定到退款。

### help.topic_htlc_text
EN: Hash-locked swaps that either pay or refund.
ZH: 哈希锁定的互换：要么付款，要么退款。

### help.topic_htlc_title
EN: Hash time-locked contracts
ZH: 哈希时间锁定合约

### help.topic_instant_body
EN: # One screen, no order book
Instant trade buys or sells at the current market price without building limit orders by hand.
Enter what you give and the wallet previews what you get, fee included, before anything signs.
# When to use the desk instead
Large sizes move thin books: the desk's limit orders with exact prices beat instant fills past a few percent of visible depth.
Instant is for convenience size; the desk is for precision size.
ZH: # 一屏，无订单簿
闪兑按当前市价买卖，无需手工建限价单。
输入付出，钱包预览所得，含手续费，签名前先看。
# 何时改用操作台
大单会推走单薄订单簿：超过可见深度几个点，操作台的精确限价单优于闪兑成交。
闪兑图方便小单；操作台图精确大单。

### help.topic_instant_text
EN: One-screen simple buy and sell without building orders by hand.
ZH: 一屏简单买卖，无需手工建单。

### help.topic_instant_title
EN: Instant trade
ZH: 闪兑

### help.topic_invoice_body
EN: # Ask to be paid, precisely
Invoices name an asset, an amount, a recipient, and an optional memo, packed into a shareable request.
Send the link or code; the payer's wallet prefills everything, leaving only review and sign.
# Paying one
Open an invoice to see exactly what is asked before your wallet builds the transfer. Verify the recipient name yourself — links can lie.
ZH: # 精确求付
发票写明资产、金额、收方与可选备注，打包为可分享请求。
发链接或码；付款方钱包预填全部，只剩核对与签名。
# 付一张
打开发票先看清要什么，钱包再构建划转。收方名称自己验——链接会撒谎。

### help.topic_invoice_text
EN: Request a specific payment with a shareable invoice.
ZH: 以可分享发票请求特定付款。

### help.topic_invoice_title
EN: Invoices
ZH: 发票

### help.topic_lists_body
EN: # Who may hold your assets
Asset issuers can restrict holding and transfer to listed accounts: allow-lists for compliance, block-lists for bad actors.
Check an asset's lists before accepting it — a token you cannot move is a souvenir, not money.
# Blocking users
Your personal block list mutes accounts across the app's social surfaces. It changes nothing on-chain; it changes what you have to look at.
ZH: # 谁可持有您的资产
资产发行者可把持有与划转限于名单账户：允许名单合规，屏蔽名单挡坏人。
接受代币前先查其名单——动不了的代币是纪念品，不是钱。
# 屏蔽用户
个人屏蔽名单在应用社交面静音账户。它不改链上任何东西；只改您须看的东西。

### help.topic_lists_text
EN: Control who can hold or transact your assets.
ZH: 控制谁能持有或划转您的资产。

### help.topic_lists_title
EN: Allow and block lists
ZH: 允许与屏蔽名单

### help.topic_menu_body
EN: # Site menu
The Menu page lists every screen in this wallet by section, so any desk is one tap away.
ZH: # 站点菜单
菜单页面按分组列出本钱包的每个界面，任何操作台都触手可及。

### help.topic_menu_text
EN: Every page in this wallet, grouped the way the navigation menu groups them.
ZH: 本钱包的每个页面，按导航菜单的分组方式排列。

### help.topic_menu_title
EN: Site menu
ZH: 站点菜单

### help.topic_news_body
EN: # No in-app feed, by decision
This wallet ships no news feed: the reference UI pulled headlines from an external blog service, and bundling a hosted feed would break the day its owner moves it. No fetch is attempted, so there is no spinner and no fetch-error panel.
# Staying current instead
The connection line on the News page is always live, and project discussion happens in the linked community chats under Help.
ZH: # 无内置源，有意为之
本钱包无新闻源：参考界面从外部博客服务拉头条，打包托管源哪天主人一搬即坏。不取数，故无转圈亦无取数错板。
# 转而保持实时
新闻页连接线永远在线，项目讨论在“帮助”下链接的社区群。

### help.topic_news_text
EN: Why this wallet ships no in-app news feed.
ZH: 本钱包为何不带应用内新闻源。

### help.topic_news_title
EN: News
ZH: 新闻

### help.topic_password_body
EN: # Re-encrypt everything
Changing the password re-encrypts the whole local vault under a new passphrase: enter the current one, choose a unique replacement, and confirm.
# Verify before you walk away
Lock and unlock once with the new passphrase before funding anything — a typo here plus a lost brainkey means lost funds.
# Short or reused passwords fall to guessing; a unique passphrase written on paper does not.
ZH: # 全部重加密
改密码把整个本地保险库按新口令重加密：输当前，选唯一替换，确认。
# 走前先验
注资前先锁定解锁一次，新口令走一遍——笔误加丢脑密钥即丢资金。
# 简短或复用密码易被猜中；写在纸上的唯一口令则不会。

### help.topic_password_text
EN: Re-encrypt the local vault with a new passphrase.
ZH: 以新口令重加密本地保险库。

### help.topic_pmo_body
EN: # Branded prediction houses
A prediction market organization is a parent asset carrying a machine-readable charter: name, website, resolution policy, and dispute rules.
Sub-markets issue under it as dotted names (HOUSE.ELECTION2028), so holders can verify who stands behind a market before trusting its resolution.
# Creating and joining
Create an organization from the prediction page, then issue sub-markets beneath it. Long dotted names also pay the cheapest creation-fee tier.
Browsing organizations shows each house with its active and expired market counts — empty houses with no markets earn no trust.
ZH: # 品牌预测机构
预测市场机构是携带机器可读章程的母资产：名称、网站、裁决政策与争议规则。
子市场以带点名称发行 (HOUSE.ELECTION2028)，信任其裁决前可先验谁背书。
# 创建与加入
在预测页创建机构，再在其下发行子市场。带点长名还享最便宜创建费档。
浏览机构展示每家活跃与过期市场数——无市场的空壳不值得信任。

### help.topic_pmo_text
EN: Branded houses that issue prediction markets under one name.
ZH: 以统一名义发行预测市场的品牌机构。

### help.topic_pmo_title
EN: Prediction organizations
ZH: 预测机构

### help.topic_pools_body
EN: # Supply two assets, earn the flow
Liquidity pools hold pairs of assets and price swaps between them automatically. Suppliers deposit both sides and earn a cut of every swap fee, proportional to their share.
# Staking pool shares
Depositing mints share tokens tracking your slice. Stake them to earn, unstake to leave; updating fees or deleting an empty pool are owner actions with confirms.
# Impermanent reality
If prices drift apart after you deposit, withdrawing buys back less value than holding both assets would have. Fees must outrun that drift — check the pool's volume before committing size.
ZH: # 存两种资产，赚每笔流水
流动性资金池持有资产对并自动定价兑换。供应商存入两侧，按份额分享每笔兑换手续费。
# 质押资金池份额
存入即铸造份额代币，记录您的占比。质押生息，解押离开；更新手续费或删除空池是所有者操作，均有确认。
# 无常现实
存入后价格走散，取出买回的价值不如一直持有两种资产。手续费须跑赢偏离——重仓前先看资金池交易量。

### help.topic_pools_text
EN: Supply two assets, earn a cut of every swap; stake pool shares.
ZH: 存入两种资产，分享每笔兑换；质押资金池份额。

### help.topic_pools_title
EN: Liquidity pools
ZH: 流动性资金池

### help.topic_prediction_body
EN: # YES/NO shares on real outcomes
Prediction market assets are SmartCoins whose feed tracks a real-world condition — an election, a launch, a price level — stated in plain English with an expiry.
Buy YES by buying the asset; the feed price is the market's live probability. After expiry the issuer settles at 1.0 (happened) or 0.0 (didn't), and winners redeem collateral.
# Reading a market
The detail view shows condition, expiry, feed history, and the probability in four formats: implied percent, decimal, fractional, and American.
No price means no probability — the screen says so instead of inventing fifty percent.
# Positions and portfolio
Holdings show average cost against current price with unrealised profit and loss. Settle settled-market holdings for collateral; sell live ones back on the desk.
ZH: # 现实结果的 YES/NO 份额
预测市场资产是喂价跟踪现实条件的智能币——选举、发射、价格位——条件用白话写明到期。
买入资产即买入是方；喂价即市场实时概率。到期后发行者按 1.0（发生）或 0.0（未发生）结算，胜者赎回抵押物。
# 怎么看市场
详情页展示条件、到期、喂价历史与四种概率：隐含百分比、小数、分数与美式。
无价格即无概率——页面明说，而不编造五成。
# 仓位与组合
持仓展示均价对现价与未实现盈亏。已结算市场的持仓结算取出抵押物；未结算的回操作台卖出。

### help.topic_prediction_text
EN: YES/NO shares on real-world outcomes with live probabilities.
ZH: 现实结果的 YES/NO 份额，附实时概率。

### help.topic_prediction_title
EN: Prediction markets
ZH: 预测市场

### help.topic_proposals_body
EN: # Pending multi-signature actions
Proposals wait for approvals or expiry: transfers, updates, and bundle wraps proposed by one party for others to sign.
Each shows proposer, expiry, review accounts, and the enclosed operations in human rows — approve only what you understand.
# Approve, reject, or let expire
Approval adds your signature toward the threshold; rejection is on the record; expiry deletes the proposal by itself.
Treat surprise proposals as hostile until proven otherwise.
ZH: # 待批多签事项
提案等批准或到期：一方提议划转、更新与打包，他方签署。
每份展示提案人、到期、审核账户与人性化内含操作行——看不懂不批准。
# 批准、拒绝或等过期
批准加签趋阈值；拒绝留记录；到期自删除。
意外提案先视同敌意，直至证伪。

### help.topic_proposals_title
EN: Proposals
ZH: 提案

### help.topic_referrals_body
EN: # Bring users, earn splits
Registering an account names a referrer and a registrar. Every fee that account ever pays splits three ways: network, referrer, registrar.
Your splits vest and settle per maintenance interval — recent earnings show pending until the round closes.
# Lifetime leverage
Lifetime members earn bigger splits plus cashback on their own fees. The account page shows your registrar's exact cut — no hidden beneficiaries.
ZH: # 带人来，分成走
注册账户写明推荐人与注册商。该账户此后每笔手续费三切：网络、推荐人、注册商。
分成按维护间隔归属结算——回合关闭前，近期收益显示待定。
# 终身杠杆
终身会员分成更大，自付手续费还有返现。账户页展示注册商确切抽成——没有隐藏受益人。

### help.topic_referrals_text
EN: How registration splits fees between referrer and registrar.
ZH: 注册如何在推荐人与注册商之间切分手续费。

### help.topic_referrals_title
EN: Referrals
ZH: 推荐

### help.topic_register_body
EN: # Claim a name
Registration claims an on-chain account name through the faucet registrar: pick an unused name, fund the creation fee, and the registrar creates the account for you.
# Faucet reality
The testnet faucet answers reliably; the old European testnet faucet is dead and stays listed nowhere. On mainnet, creation goes through the registrar your settings name.
# After creation
Back up the new wallet before funding it — the brainkey IS the backup. Import existing keys instead under Import if the account already exists.
ZH: # 认领名称
注册经水龙头注册商认领链上账户名：选未用名，付创建费，注册商为您建账户。
# 水龙头现实
测试网水龙头应答可靠；旧欧洲测试网水龙头已死且不再列任何地方。主网创建走设置所写注册商。
# 建后
注资前先备份新钱包——脑密钥即备份。账户已存在则在“导入”下导入现有密钥。

### help.topic_register_text
EN: Claim a name through the faucet registrar.
ZH: 经水龙头注册商认领名称。

### help.topic_register_title
EN: Creating an account
ZH: 创建账户

### help.topic_samet_body
EN: # Pooled funds, same asset in and out
Same-T funds pool one asset from many suppliers. Borrowers draw against a fund and repay with interest; the chain enforces balances and schedules.
# Denomination discipline
Funds denominate in whole units (1M base): create, draw, and repay in the same asset, and mind the fund's limits before committing size.
# Same-transaction rule
Paired fund operations belong in one transaction: split legs can strand half a deal. The desk builds the pair together — review once, sign once.
ZH: # 同进同出的汇集资金
Same-T 资金池汇集多供应商的同一资产。借入方按池支取并还本付息；链上强制余额与计划。
# 面额纪律
资金池以整单位计价（1M 基础）：创建、支取、还款用同一资产，投入前看清池限额。
# 同笔交易规则
成对池操作须进同一笔交易：拆开两边可能让半边交易悬空。操作台成对构建——核对一次，签名一次。

### help.topic_samet_text
EN: Pooled same-asset funds with draws and repayments.
ZH: 同资产汇集的资金池，支取与还款。

### help.topic_samet_title
EN: Same-T Funds
ZH: Same-T 资金池

### help.topic_settings_body
EN: # Nodes: pick by health, not habit
The node table probes every endpoint live: latency plus head age, witness participation, and irreversible lag, graded Good through Forked.
A fast-but-stale or forked node is labeled, never shown as healthy. Switch with one tap; the footer always shows where you are connected.
# Find more nodes
The opt-in discovery button searches public node lists and probes what it finds. It names the privacy cost up front, runs cancellable in the background, and only ever proposes candidates — nothing joins your list without your tap.
# Themes, language, housekeeping
Three themes, twelve languages, custom nodes with add and remove, plus wallet, password, and reset controls — all on this one page, all instant, no reload.
# Candle depth
The candle-count input sets how many candles charts fetch (default 2000). Deeper windows cost more history calls — raise it for research, lower it on slow connections.
ZH: # 节点：按健康选，不凭习惯
节点表实时探测每条接入：延迟加头部年龄、见证人参与与不可逆滞后，评级从良好到分叉。
又快又旧或分叉的节点会被标注，绝不装作健康。一键切换；页脚永远显示连在哪里。
# 发现更多节点
可选的发现按钮搜索公开节点名单并探测所见。它先讲明隐私代价，后台可取消，只提名候选——未经您点击，绝不加入名单。
# 主题、语言、杂务
三套主题、十二种语言，自定义节点增删，加钱包、密码与重置控制——全在一页，即时生效，无需重载。
# K 线深度
K 线数量输入设置图表取多少根（默认 2000）。窗口越深历史调用越多——研究调大，慢连接调小。

### help.topic_settings_text
EN: Pick API nodes by live health, switch themes and language.
ZH: 按实时健康选 API 节点，切换主题与语言。

### help.topic_settings_title
EN: Settings and nodes
ZH: 设置与节点

### help.topic_spotlight_body
EN: # A showcase, not an exchange
Spotlight is the reference UI's showcase grid: tiles that point at wallet features (HTLC, Direct Debit) plus a recurring-orders helper. It moves no funds itself and carries no chain operation.
# Recurring orders helper
The helper places N limit orders NOW at stepped prices — one transaction per order, each with its own confirm. No scheduler runs in a static page: closing the page places nothing further.
ZH: # 展示，非交易所
Spotlight 是参考界面的展示格：磁贴指向钱包功能（哈希时间锁定合约、直接扣款）加循环下单小帮手。它自己不动资金，不带链操作。
# 循环下单小帮手
小帮手按阶梯价现在下 N 笔限价单——一单一笔交易，各有确认。静态页无调度器运行：关页后不再下单。

### help.topic_spotlight_text
EN: Showcase tiles plus a recurring-orders helper.
ZH: 展示磁贴加循环下单小帮手。

### help.topic_tickets_body
EN: # Lock stake, grow weight
Vote-locked tickets convert stake plus time into voting weight: longer locks weigh more, and weight decays nothing until unlock.
Create a ticket from liquid stake, top it up, and claim it back when the lock ends.
# Where weight counts
Ticket weight feeds witness, committee, and worker votes through the normal slate — publish the slate to activate it.
ZH: # 锁质押，长权重
投票锁定票证把质押加时间换成投票权重：锁越长越重，解锁前绝不衰减。
从活期质押建票证，可追加，到期领回。
# 权重用在哪里
票证权重经正常选票名单计入见证人、理事会与工人投票——发布选票名单激活之。

### help.topic_tickets_text
EN: Lock stake for voting weight that grows with lock time.
ZH: 锁定质押换随锁长增长的投票权重。

### help.topic_tickets_title
EN: Vote-locked tickets
ZH: 投票锁定票证

### help.topic_topops_body
EN: # What the chain does most
Top operations counts real operation types across the last 200 blocks: transfers, orders, fills, votes — ranked with shares, plus a donut for the shape of chain activity.
Refresh re-runs the window. Testnet works here, unlike the old stats pages that were mainnet-only.
# Two desks, one count
Top Operations pairs the rankings with the activity donut; the Operations desk shows the same window as a plain ranked table. Both read the same blocks.
# Reading it
A healthy chain shows transfers and order flow on top with governance and maintenance underneath. Spikes in exotic types deserve a look in the explorer.
ZH: # 链上最多在做什么
热门操作统计最近 200 区块的真实操作类型：划转、订单、成交、投票——排名加占比，另有环图展示链动态形状。
刷新重跑窗口。测试网在此可用，不像旧统计页仅主网。
# 两台，一数
热门操作把排名与动态环图放一起；“操作”操作台把同一窗口展示为纯排名表。两者读同一批区块。
# 怎么看
健康链上划转与订单流居前，治理与维护居后。生僻类型突增，值得去浏览器看看。

### help.topic_topops_text
EN: Which chain operations run hottest, counted from recent blocks.
ZH: 从近期区块计数，哪些链操作最热。

### help.topic_topops_title
EN: Top operations
ZH: 热门操作

### help.topic_tour_body
EN: # Five steps, then freedom
The first-run tour walks the dashboard, market strip, charts, trade panels, and beyond: where to look, what each part does, how to leave. Dismiss any time; it never blocks.
# Replay
Take tour replays from the dashboard whenever you want a refresher — same five steps, same dismiss.
ZH: # 五步，然后自由
首次导览走总览、市场条、图表、交易面板等：看哪里，每块做什么，怎么走，随时可关；从不挡路。
# 重播
随时从总览重播导览——同样五步，同样可关。

### help.topic_tour_text
EN: The five-step first-run walkthrough; replay it any time.
ZH: 五步首次漫游；随时重播。

EN: Welcome tour
ZH: 欢迎导览

### help.topic_transfer_body
EN: # Sending assets
Pick the asset, the recipient account, and the amount; the wallet adds the chain fee and shows the full confirm before you sign.
Double-check the name — chain transfers do not reverse.
# Encrypted memos
Attach a memo to transfer text privately: it encrypts to the recipient's memo key and only they can read it.
Leave the memo empty for a plain public transfer.
# Fees
Every transfer pays the chain fee from the fee schedule. The confirm dialog shows the exact fee before you sign — never estimate, never guess.
ZH: # 发送资产
选资产、收方账户与金额；钱包加上链手续费，在签名前展示完整确认。
复核名称——链上划转不可撤销。
# 加密备注
附备注可私密传话：备注加密给收方的备注密钥，只有对方能读。
备注留空即普通公开划转。
# 手续费
每笔划转按费率表付链手续费。确认对话框在签名前展示确切手续费——从不估算，从不猜测。

### help.topic_translation-limitations_body
EN: A translation marked machine-filled was written by a machine. Nobody has read it to check that it says what the English says — which is why every language except English carries the marker chip in this wallet's header. English is the text the others were translated from, so it carries no marker.

# What the * on a line means
A * on a signing line means two things at once: the wording was filled by a machine, and the original English is one tap away. Tap the * and the English appears under the line exactly as this wallet's English master stores it — the same text every other language was translated from, not a paraphrase of it.

The marker follows the line, not the words inside it. A * marks one whole translated line, and the wallet picks those lines by a fixed rule: every line on a signing, irreversible-action or recovery screen — up to a length cap, since a long paragraph is covered by this article instead — plus any line anywhere whose English carries danger wording. So a line that only names an id or an amount still carries one (the To field on a transfer, for one), and a long paragraph that mentions an id does not. A bare chain value — an amount in a cell, an id in a column, an asset symbol — is not a translated line at all, so it never carries one: there is no English wording behind it to compare against.

# What the confidence levels mean
Every language this wallet ships carries one rating, listed in the table below. High means the wording tracks the English closely and reads naturally. Good means it is usable, though a phrase may still read awkwardly. Moderate means read it as a draft and check the English before you rely on it.

Every rating below is the machine that wrote the strings grading its own work; nobody independent has audited them. A rating describes what has been checked so far, for the language as a whole rather than line by line. English itself is the reference: it is written by hand, and every other language is translated from it.

# How to correct a string
Corrections start with a report. Say which language the line was in, give the key that line discloses, paste the English it was supposed to say, and suggest the wording you would use instead.

- One report per line keeps a fix easy to apply.
- Report the signing screens first: a wrong sentence on a confirm dialog is the costly kind.
- Use the link at the end of this article. It opens an issue already labelled for translations on this project's tracker, so nothing has to be retyped.

# Corrections are the only path to human reviewed
Nothing else moves a string off machine-filled: not how often a language is used, not a second machine agreeing with the first, not a translation memory. A string becomes human reviewed when a person reads it in its own language and accepts it, and a line is human reviewed only for the language that was actually checked.

Until then the marker stays where it is. A translation nobody has read beats no translation at all, but it is not the same thing as one a person stood behind.
ZH: 标为机器填充的翻译由机器写成。没有人读过它、核对它是否与英文含义一致——正因如此，本钱包页眉中除英文外的每种语言都带有标记徽标。英文是其余语言翻译所依据的原文，因此不带标记。

# 行上的 * 意味着什么
签名行上的 * 同时表示两件事：措辞由机器填充，且原始英文触手可及。点一下 *，英文就会显示在该行下方，与本钱包英文母本中存储的完全一致——也就是其余语言翻译所依据的原文，而不是它的转述。

标记跟随的是整行，而不是行内的词语。一个 * 标记一整行翻译文本，钱包按固定规则挑选这些行：签名、不可逆操作或恢复类页面上的每一行——但有长度上限，因为长段落由本文说明——再加上任何页面中英文原文带有危险措辞的行。因此，只写出 ID 或金额的行仍会带标记（例如转账的收款方字段），而提到 ID 的长段落则不会。裸露的链上数值——单元格里的金额、列中的 ID、资产符号——根本不算翻译行，因此永远不带标记：它背后没有可比的英文措辞。

# 置信等级的含义
本钱包提供的每种语言都有一个评级，列于下表。高表示措辞紧贴英文、读起来自然。良好表示可用，但个别短语可能仍显生硬。中等表示请当作草稿阅读，依赖它之前先核对英文。

以下每个评级都是写出这些字符串的机器给自己打的分；没有独立第三方审计过。评级描述的是迄今已核查的内容，且针对整种语言而非逐行。英文本身是基准：它由人工撰写，其余语言都由它翻译而来。

# 如何更正一条字符串
更正从一份报告开始。请说明该行属于哪种语言，给出该行披露的键，粘贴它本应表达的英文，并建议您希望使用的措辞。

- 每行一份报告，更正才好落地。
- 请优先报告签名页面：确认对话框上的错句代价最高。
- 使用本文末尾的链接。它会在本项目的追踪器上打开一个已标注翻译标签的 issue，无需重复填写任何内容。

# 更正是走向人工审阅的唯一途径
除此之外，没有任何东西能把字符串移出机器填充状态：使用人数、第二台机器的认同、翻译记忆都不行。一条字符串在某个人用母语读过并认可后，即为人工审阅；一行文本只有对真正被核查的那种语言才算人工审阅。

在此之前，标记保持原位。没人读过的翻译胜过完全没有翻译，但它与有人为之背书的翻译不是一回事。

### help.topic_translation-limitations_text
EN: Machine-filled translations are labeled; the English reference is always one tap away. Help us fix a line.
ZH: 机器填充的翻译均有标记；英文原文始终触手可及。欢迎帮我们修正某一行的译文。

### help.topic_translation-limitations_title
EN: Translation limitations
ZH: 翻译局限

### help.topic_trollbox_body
EN: # Public chat on-chain
Trollbox channels live on the blockchain itself: every message is a tiny paid transaction, which is exactly what keeps spam uneconomical.
Posting costs a fraction of a cent per kilobyte — reads are free and need no login.
# Channels and manners
Pick a channel, read first, then post. Messages are permanent and public to the whole world — never post secrets, keys, or personal data.
# Cost honesty
The composer shows the live fee before you sign. Long messages cost more kilobytes; split essays across posts.
ZH: # 链上的公共聊天
Trollbox 频道就在区块链上：每条消息都是微小有偿交易，这正是垃圾信息贵到发不起的原因。
发帖按千字节收零点几分钱——阅读免费，无需登录。
# 频道与礼仪
选频道，先潜水再发言。消息永久公开，全世界可见——绝不发布秘密、密钥或个人数据。
# 费用诚实
编辑器在签名前展示实时手续费。长文按千字节更贵；长篇请分条发。

### help.topic_trollbox_text
EN: On-chain public chat rooms, paid per kilobyte like any transaction.
ZH: 链上公共聊天室，按千字节付费如任何交易。

### help.topic_trollbox_title
EN: Trollbox chat
ZH: Trollbox 聊天

### help.topic_txbuilder_body
EN: # Several operations, one signature round
The builder composes multiple operations — transfers, votes, stakes — into a single transaction you review once and sign once.
Add from Transfer, Voting, or Pool stake screens, or queue manually; export and import envelopes to move drafts between sessions.
# Review before you sign
Every queued operation renders a human row with amounts in human terms. The fee preview covers the whole bundle with one chain fee call.
# Proposals from bundles
Wrap any bundle as a multi-signature proposal instead of sending it: proposers, expiry, and review accounts, all before signatures.
ZH: # 多个操作，一轮签名
构建器把多个操作——划转、投票、质押——组进一笔交易，核对一次，签名一次。
从划转、投票或资金池质押页添加，或手工排队；导出/导入信封可在会话间转移草稿。
# 签名前核对
排队操作逐行人性化渲染，金额日常单位。手续费预览用一次链手续费查询覆盖整包。
# 包转提案
任一包都可改为多签提案而不直接发出：提案人、到期、审核账户，都在签名前定好。

### help.topic_txbuilder_title
EN: Transaction builder
ZH: 交易构建器

### help.topic_uris_body
EN: # Links that prefill payments
BitShares URIs (bitshares:…) pack a payment request — recipient, asset, amount, memo — into a shareable link. Opening one prefills the transfer or invoice form; only review and sign remain.
# Verify before signing
Links can lie about who they pay: check the recipient name yourself. The wallet never signs from a link alone.
# CSV history export
Account history exports to CoinTracking-compatible CSV for taxes and records. Amounts export as display decimals with symbols; dates stay empty rather than guessed.
ZH: # 预填付款的链接
BitShares URI (bitshares:…) 把付款请求——收方、资产、金额、备注——打包为可分享链接。打开即预填划转或发票表单；只剩核对与签名。
# 签名前核验
链接谎报收款人：收方名称自己验。钱包绝不凭链接即签。
# CSV 历史导出
账户历史导出为 CoinTracking 兼容 CSV，供税务与记账。金额按日常小数加符号导出；日期宁空不猜。

### help.topic_uris_text
EN: BitShares links that prefill payments, plus CSV history export.
ZH: 预填付款的 BitShares 链接，加 CSV 历史导出。

### help.topic_uris_title
EN: Payment requests and exports
ZH: 付款请求与导出

### help.topic_vesting_body
EN: # Locked now, yours later
Vesting balances release on schedule: worker pay, referral rewards, and large fees arrive over time instead of at once.
Each balance shows its schedule and claimable remainder; claiming is one transaction with one fee.
# Claim when due
Claimed funds land liquid immediately. Unclaimed schedules simply wait — nothing expires, nothing decays.
ZH: # 锁定现在，归您未来
归属余额按期释放：工人薪水、推荐奖励与大额手续费分期到，而非一次。
每笔展示计划与可领余；领取是一笔交易一份手续费。
# 到期即领
领到的资金即时变为活期可用。不领的计划只管等——不过期，不衰减。

### help.topic_vesting_text
EN: Time-locked balances that release on schedule; claim when due.
ZH: 按期释放的时间锁定余额；到期领取。

### help.topic_voting_body
EN: # Why your vote matters
Voting keeps BitShares secure and funded: it picks the block producers, the policy setters, and which worker projects get paid.
Your vote's weight follows the BTS you hold. If community mechanics are new to you, a proxy (below) is the recommended start.
# Proxy: delegate when unsure
A proxy is an account you trust to vote with your weight on your behalf — like electing a representative.
While a proxy is set, you cannot vote directly for witnesses, committee members, or workers. You can release the proxy any time and vote yourself. Remember to publish your changes.
# Witnesses
Witnesses build and sign blocks from validated transactions. Vote for as many as you like; each gets your full weight. Full detail lives in the Witnesses article.
# Committee
The committee sets chain policy: trading and transaction fees, block size and interval, cashback percentages, vesting periods, and similar parameters. Full detail lives in the Committee Members article.
# Workers and the budget
Workers are paid proposals climbing from proposed to active once they out-vote the refund worker, paid from a fixed daily budget first-come first-served by rank. Full detail lives in the Workers article.
ZH: # 您的选票为何重要
投票保障 BitShares 的安全与资金：选出区块生产者、政策制定者，以及哪些工人项目获得资助。
投票权重跟随您持有的 BTS。若社区机制对您还很新，建议从下文代理起步。
# 代理：拿不准就委托
代理是您信任的账户，代您行使投票权重——如同选出一位代表。
设置代理期间，您不能直接为见证人、理事会成员或工人投票。可随时解除代理、改回自己投票。记得发布更改。
# 见证人
见证人构建并签署区块。您可为任意多位投票，每位都获得您的全部权重。详情见“见证人”一文。
# 理事会
理事会制定链政策：交易与操作手续费、区块大小与间隔、返现比例、归属期等参数。详情见“理事会成员”一文。
# 工人与预算
工人是有偿提案，从提议进入活跃须超过退款工人的得票，从固定日预算中按排名先到先得支付。详情见“工人”一文。

### help.topic_voting_text
EN: Vote witnesses, committee, workers — or hand it to a proxy.
ZH: 为见证人、理事会、工人投票——也可交给代理。

### help.topic_voting_title
EN: Voting
ZH: 投票

### help.topic_wallets_body
EN: # A web app with a local vault
This application runs in your browser and talks to a chain node as its gateway to the network. Everything secret stays in your browser's local vault.
# No cloud login
This wallet has no username-and-password login: every wallet here is local to one browser. To use your account on a new browser or computer, start from the same brainkey — there are no credentials that open it from anywhere on their own.
# Local wallet
A local wallet is a database inside one specific browser. It will not follow you to another computer or browser unless you carry the brainkey over and import it.
See the Backups article before you rely on a local wallet for real funds.
# Password discipline
The password encrypts the vault. Short or reused passwords fall to guessing; a unique passphrase written on paper does not.
Changing the password re-encrypts everything — verify the current one first, then confirm the wallet still unlocks before you walk away.
ZH: # 带本地保险库的网页应用
本应用在您的浏览器中运行，并通过链节点作为进入网络的网关。所有机密都留在您浏览器的本地保险库中。
# 没有云端登录
本钱包没有用户名加密码的登录：这里的每个钱包都只存在于某一个浏览器中。要在新的浏览器或电脑上使用您的账户，请从同一个脑密钥开始——不存在任何能自行打开它的凭据。
# 本地钱包
本地钱包是某个特定浏览器内部的一个数据库。除非您把脑密钥带过去并导入，否则它不会跟随您到另一台电脑或另一个浏览器。
在用本地钱包存放真实资金之前，请先阅读“备份”一文。
# 口令纪律
口令用于加密保险库。短口令或重复使用的口令挡不住猜测；写在纸上的唯一口令则不然。
修改口令会重新加密全部内容——请先核对当前口令，再确认钱包仍能解锁，然后才离开。

### help.topic_wallets_title
EN: Wallets
ZH: 钱包

### help.topic_witnesses_body
EN: # What witnesses do
Witnesses are the block producers of BitShares. They collect validated transactions, construct new blocks, and sign them so the network can trust the chain's history.
Their role parallels miners on other chains — except here the right to produce blocks comes from shareholder votes, not hashing power.
# How they are chosen
BTS holders vote for their preferred block producers on-chain under delegated proof of stake. The candidates with the most vote weight earn the producer slots.
You may vote for as many witnesses as you like, and each one receives your full vote weight — voting for more never dilutes your support.
# Voting well
Candidate statements and community discussion are the honest way to pick: look for reliable block production, honest price feeds, and steady maintenance.
If you do not want to research every candidate, set a proxy you trust instead of voting blind. Publish your changes so the chain records them.
# In this wallet
Browse producers, your current votes, and the proxy setting under Voting, and confirm any slate change before signing — votes are on-chain transactions with fees.
ZH: # 见证人做什么
见证人是 BitShares 的区块生产者。收集已验证交易、构建新区块并签名，网络据此信任链历史。
其角色类似其他链的矿工——只是在这里，出块权来自股东投票，而非算力。
# 如何选出
BTS 持有者在链上按委托权益证明投票选出心仪的区块生产者。得票权重居前的候选人获得生产者席位。
您可为任意多位见证人投票，每位都获得您的全部投票权重——多投绝不稀释支持。
# 投好票
候选人声明与社区讨论是诚实的选择方式：看其出块是否可靠、喂价是否诚实、维护是否稳定。
若不想逐一研究候选人，请设置信任的代理，而不要盲投。发布更改，让链上记录您的选择。
# 在本钱包中
在“投票”下浏览生产者、当前投票与代理设置，确认选票名单变更后再签名——投票是收手续费的链上交易。

### help.topic_witnesses_text
EN: Block producers that validate transactions and build blocks; vote for them or through a proxy.
ZH: 验证交易并构建区块的出块者；可直接为其投票或通过代理投票。

### help.topic_witnesses_title
EN: Witnesses
ZH: 见证人

### help.topic_workers_body
EN: # Work paid by the chain
Workers are proposals to do something useful — development, marketing, infrastructure — in exchange for a salary paid by the blockchain itself.
Each proposal states at minimum a start and end date, a daily pay, a maximum total pay, and a link explaining the work. Check that link before voting.
# Lifecycle: proposed, active, expired
Proposed workers are collecting votes. Once a proposal out-votes the refund worker it becomes active and starts getting paid; if support drops below that bar it is defunded.
Expired proposals stay visible for history after their end date passes.
# How the budget works
All workers share one fixed daily budget, paid first-come first-served by vote rank: the top-voted proposals collect their daily pay until the budget runs out.
A proposal can be approved yet earn nothing if higher-ranked workers already consumed the day's funds — rank matters, not just approval.
# In this wallet
Read proposals, compare pay and dates, and cast or withdraw your votes under Voting. Publish your changes so the chain records them.
ZH: # 由链支付的工作
工人是做有用之事换取区块链本身支付薪水的提案——开发、推广、基础设施等。
每份提案至少写明起止日期、日薪、最高总额与说明工作的链接。投票前请先看链接。
# 生命周期：提议、活跃、过期
提议中的工人正在拉票。得票超过退款工人即进入活跃并开始领薪；支持跌回线下即停止资助。
过期提案在结束日期后仍可见，供查考历史。
# 预算如何运作
全部工人共享固定日预算，按投票排名先到先得：排名居前的提案先领日薪，领完即止。
提案获批未必有收入——若排名居前的已耗尽当日资金，纵获批也分文无收——排名与获批同样重要。
# 在本钱包中
在“投票”下阅读提案、比较薪水与日期，投出或撤回您的选票。发布更改，让链上记录。

### samet.same_asset_same_t_funds_borrowing_and_repayin
EN: Same-asset (Same-T) funds: borrowing and repaying happen in ONE transaction [67 borrow + 68 repay] — the chain rejects a lone borrow. Rates are percent at denom 1,000,000.
ZH: 同资产（Same-T）资金池：借入与还款在同一笔交易中完成 [67 借入 + 68 还款] — 链上拒绝单独的借入操作。费率为分母为 1,000,000 的百分比。

### seo.desc_account
EN: View this BitShares account — balances, orders and history read live from the chain. No login needed.
ZH: 查看此 BitShares 账户——余额、订单与历史实时读自链上。无需登录。

### seo.desc_dashboard
EN: BitShares dashboard — balances, markets and chain activity at a glance. Browse freely; keys stay on your device.
ZH: BitShares 仪表盘——余额、市场与链上动态一览。可自由浏览；密钥留在您的设备上。

### seo.desc_explorer
EN: Explore BitShares blocks, transactions and assets — live chain data, browsable with no login.
ZH: 浏览 BitShares 的区块、交易与资产——实时链上数据，无需登录即可查看。

### seo.desc_help
EN: BitShares wallet help — guides for accounts, trading, voting and recovery. Start here when stuck.
ZH: BitShares 钱包帮助——账户、交易、投票与恢复的指南。遇到困难请从这里开始。

### seo.desc_markets
EN: Browse BitShares order-book markets by 24h volume and open any pair's trading desk. No login needed.
ZH: 按 24 小时成交量浏览 BitShares 订单簿市场，打开任意交易对的交易台。无需登录。

### seo.desc_pools
EN: Browse BitShares liquidity pools — pairs, balances and activity read live from the chain. No login needed.
ZH: 浏览 BitShares 流动性资金池——交易对、余额与动态实时读自链上。无需登录。

### seo.desc_xrates
EN: Every pool asset priced in BTS and more at last swap prices. No login needed.
ZH: 每个资金池资产按最近一次兑换价格折算为 BTS 等单位。无需登录。

### tour.s2_body
EN: This strip lists starred and featured markets with live prices. Choose any chip to open that trading desk.
ZH: 这条带子列出已收藏和推荐的市场及其实时价格。点击任意标签即可打开该交易台。

### tour.s2_cta
EN: Open the Exchange
ZH: 打开交易所

### tour.s2_title
EN: Pick a market
ZH: 选择市场

### tour.s3_body
EN: Price candles, volume, and depth plus the indicators menu: overlays like SMA and EMA, oscillators like RSI, MACD, and Stochastic. Open the exchange to see it live.
ZH: 价格 K 线、成交量与深度，再加上指标菜单：SMA 与 EMA 等叠加指标，RSI、MACD 与随机指标等振荡指标。打开交易所即可实时查看。

### tour.s3_title
EN: See live price charts
ZH: 查看实时价格图表

### tour.s4_body
EN: The Buy and Sell panels accept any numbers for practice. Nothing leaves your machine until you review and sign with an unlocked wallet. Open the exchange to try it.
ZH: 买入与卖出面板接受任意数字，供您练习。在您核对并用已解锁的钱包签名之前，不会有任何东西离开您的设备。打开交易所即可试用。

### tour.s4_title
EN: Practice buying and selling
ZH: 练习买入与卖出

### tour.s5_body
EN: Liquidity pools, the chain explorer, voting, and help are one click away. Everything stays viewable while locked: unlock only to sign.
ZH: 流动性资金池、链浏览器、投票和帮助都一键可达。锁定状态下一切仍可查看：仅签名时才需解锁。

### about.making_body
EN: What follows is the original build story: every prompt that created this wallet, from "acquire bitshares-ui" on 26 September 2026 to the issue-1 fix on 3 October, with the builders' replies — preserved unedited. It records the decisions this wallet stands on: walking away from another React uplift after issue #3583 and its thousand-hour trap, so this wallet depends on nothing with a release cycle; signing every transaction locally like the old wallet instead of outsourcing it; three themes with the classic look as default; numbers in human terms, never raw chain integers; phone-first layouts from the first slice; and fees read from the live chain, never estimated. Read it as history: this is how the wallet got built.
HI: आगे मूल निर्माण कथा दी गई है: इस वॉलेट को बनाने वाला हर प्रॉम्प्ट, 26 सितंबर 2026 को “acquire bitshares-ui” से लेकर 3 अक्टूबर के issue-1 सुधार तक, निर्माताओं के उत्तरों सहित — बिना किसी बदलाव के सुरक्षित। यह उन निर्णयों को दर्ज करती है जिन पर यह वॉलेट खड़ा है: issue #3583 और उसके हज़ार-घंटे के जाल से बाहर निकलकर एक और React उन्नयन छोड़ना, ताकि यह वॉलेट किसी रिलीज़-साइकल वाली चीज़ पर निर्भर न रहे; पुराने वॉलेट की तरह हर लेनदेन स्वयं स्थानीय रूप से हस्ताक्षरित करना, उसे बाहर सौंपने के बजाय; तीन थीम, जिनमें क्लासिक रूप मानक है; संख्याएँ मानव पदों में, कभी कच्चे चेन पूर्णांक नहीं; पहली स्लाइस से ही फ़ोन-प्रथम लेआउट; और शुल्क लाइव चेन से पढ़े गए, कभी अनुमानित नहीं। इसे इतिहास की तरह पढ़ें: वॉलेट इसी तरह बना।

### about.making_title
EN: Making of this wallet
HI: इस वॉलेट का निर्माण

### about.s1_body
EN: Accounts live in an encrypted vault on your device, and every transaction is signed locally before broadcast. The nodes you connect to never see your secrets — which is also why backups are yours alone: lose the brainkey and nobody can recover your funds.
HI: खाते आपके डिवाइस पर एन्क्रिप्टेड तिजोरी में रहते हैं, और प्रत्येक लेनदेन ब्रॉडकास्ट से पहले स्थानीय रूप से हस्ताक्षरित होता है। जिन नोडों से जुड़ते हैं वे आपके रहस्य कभी नहीं देखते — इसीलिए बैकअप भी आपके ही हैं: ब्रेनकी खोई तो कोई फ़ंड पुनर्प्राप्त नहीं कर सकता।

### about.s1_title
EN: Your keys never leave this browser
HI: आपकी कुंजियाँ यह ब्राउज़र कभी नहीं छोड़तीं

### about.s2_body
EN: Order books, liquidity pools, swaps, borrowing, credit, prediction markets, and voting all settle on-chain. What you see is the chain itself — books you can trade against, not pictures of books.
HI: ऑर्डर बुक, तरलता पूल, स्वैप, उधार, क्रेडिट, भविष्यवाणी मार्केट और वोटिंग सब ऑन-चेन सेटल होते हैं। जो देखते हैं वही चेन है — बुक जिन पर व्यापार हो सकता है, बुक की तस्वीरें नहीं।

### about.s2_title
EN: Trade on the real order book
HI: वास्तविक ऑर्डर बुक पर ट्रेड करें

### about.s3_body
EN: The wallet it replaces died under a hundred stale packages and a toolchain nobody can reproduce. Built to avoid release-cycle dependencies: no framework, no package manager, no build step — the smallest thing that can still run in a browser a decade from now.
HI: जिस वॉलेट यह बदलता है वह सौ पुराने पैकेजों और ऐसी टूलचेन के बोझ से मरा जिसे कोई पुनः नहीं बना सकता। रिलीज़-साइकल निर्भरताओं से बचने हेतु बनाया गया: कोई फ़्रेमवर्क नहीं, कोई पैकेज प्रबंधक नहीं, कोई बिल्ड चरण नहीं — वह न्यूनतम चीज़ जो आज से दस वर्ष बाद भी ब्राउज़र में चल सके।

### about.s3_title
EN: Runs for years with no updates
HI: बिना अपडेट वर्षों तक चलता है

### about.s4_body
EN: Returning users feel at home instantly — the same pages, panels, and words as the classic wallet — while balances, books, and connection status update live in place. Forgiving search across markets, accounts, and assets, three themes, and layouts that work from a 360px phone to a 4K trading desk.
HI: लौटने वाले उपयोगकर्ता तुरंत घर-सा महसूस करते हैं — क्लासिक वॉलेट जैसे वही पेज, पैनल और शब्द — जबकि बैलेंस, बुक व कनेक्शन स्थिति जगह-जगह लाइव अद्यतन होती रहती है। मार्केट, खाते व एसेट में क्षमादार खोज, तीन थीम, और ऐसे लेआउट जो 360px फ़ोन से 4K ट्रेडिंग डेस्क तक काम करते हैं।

### about.s4_title
EN: Same pages, live updates
HI: वही पेज, लाइव अद्यतन

### about.s5_body
EN: The chain speaks integers; you never see them. Every amount sits at its asset's decimals, every percent at its true value, and every fee is read from the live chain before you sign.
HI: चेन पूर्णांक बोलती है; आप उन्हें कभी नहीं देखते। प्रत्येक राशि अपने एसेट के दशमलव पर, प्रत्येक प्रतिशत अपने वास्तविक मान पर, और प्रत्येक शुल्क हस्ताक्षर से पहले लाइव चेन से पढ़ा जाता है।

### about.s5_title
EN: Numbers you can trust
HI: भरोसेमंद संख्याएँ

### about.s6_body
EN: Gateways are custodians holding your outside coins — read their terms as the custody deal it is. The history index is run by the community, not by this wallet. Some features have no testnet data by nature, and there is no in-app news feed by decision. Where this wallet cannot know, it says so instead of guessing.
HI: गेटवे आपके बाहरी सिक्के रखने वाले कस्टोडियन हैं — उनकी शर्तें उसी कस्टडी सौदे के रूप में पढ़ें। इतिहास इंडेक्स समुदाय चलाता है, यह वॉलेट नहीं। कुछ सुविधाओं में स्वभाव से testnet डेटा नहीं होता, और निर्णय से कोई इन-ऐप समाचार फ़ीड नहीं है। जहाँ यह वॉलेट नहीं जान सकता, वहाँ अटकल के बजाय कहता है।

### about.s6_title
EN: Honest limits
HI: ईमानदार सीमाएँ

### auth.a_local_wallet_creates_a_brainkey_on_this_dev
EN: A local wallet creates a brainkey on this device and derives the owner, active and memo keys from it. Keys never leave the device; the wallet file is encrypted with your password.
HI: स्थानीय वॉलेट इस डिवाइस पर ब्रेनकी बनाता है और उसी से मालिक, सक्रिय और मेमो कुंजियाँ बनाता है। कुंजियाँ डिवाइस कभी नहीं छोड़तीं; वॉलेट फ़ाइल आपके पासवर्ड से एन्क्रिप्ट होती है।

### auth.cloud_style_registration_picks_an_account_nam
EN: Cloud-style registration picks an account name and registers it through the faucet, which pays the creation fee. On testnet this is free; on mainnet a faucet or registrar must sponsor the name.
HI: क्लाउड-शैली पंजीकरण में फ़ॉसेट से खाता नाम चुना जाता है, जो निर्माण शुल्क देता है। testnet पर यह मुफ़्त है; mainnet पर फ़ॉसेट या रजिस्ट्रार को नाम प्रायोजित करना होगा।

### auth.multisig_body
EN: This wallet holds one key. Shared accounts need proposals + co-owner approvals, coordinated by proposal id (1.10.N). Browsing is public; only signing needs the password.
HI: यह वॉलेट एक ही कुंजी रखता है। साझा खातों हेतु प्रस्ताव + सह-स्वामी अनुमोदन चाहिए, जिनका समन्वय प्रस्ताव id (1.10.N) से होता है। ब्राउज़िंग सार्वजनिक है; पासवर्ड केवल हस्ताक्षर हेतु चाहिए।

### borrow.how_1
EN: 1. Lock collateral (e.g. BTS) to open a call order against a bitasset (e.g. bitUSD).
HI: 1. बिटएसेट (जैसे bitUSD) के विरुद्ध कॉल ऑर्डर खोलने के लिए कोलैटरल (जैसे BTS) लॉक करें।

### borrow.how_2
EN: 2. The chain must see a live price feed; falling below the maintenance ratio triggers a margin call.
HI: 2. चेन को लाइव मूल्य फ़ीड दिखना चाहिए; रखरखाव अनुपात से नीचे गिरने पर मार्जिन कॉल होती है।

### borrow.how_3
EN: 3. Top up collateral or repay debt any time with the adjust form — small steps only.
HI: 3. समायोजन फ़ॉर्म से कभी भी कोलैटरल बढ़ाएँ या कर्ज़ चुकाएँ — केवल छोटे कदम।

### borrow.how_4
EN: 4. Negative debt delta means borrowing MORE — it raises your liquidation risk.
HI: 4. नकारात्मक कर्ज़ डेल्टा का अर्थ अधिक उधार है — इससे परिसमापन जोखिम बढ़ता है।

EN: This address is not a secure context, so the browser withholds WebCrypto. The browser is current — serve over https or localhost, or open the file directly.
HI: यह पता सुरक्षित संदर्भ नहीं है, इसलिए ब्राउज़र WebCrypto उपलब्ध नहीं कराता। ब्राउज़र अद्यतन है — https या localhost से परोसें, या फ़ाइल सीधे खोलें।

### compat.msg
EN: Some features need a modern browser (WebSocket, WebCrypto, BigInt, local storage). Missing here: %(missing)s. Browsing still works — wallet signing may not.
HI: कुछ सुविधाओं को आधुनिक ब्राउज़र चाहिए (WebSocket, WebCrypto, BigInt, स्थानीय संग्रहण)। यहाँ गायब: %(missing)s। ब्राउज़िंग चलती है — वॉलेट हस्ताक्षर न हो सके।

### createworker.broadcast_unavailable_the_op_34_serializer_is
EN: Broadcast unavailable: the op-34 serializer is not loaded in this bundle (tx.js/tx-send.js). The preview above is exact — reload the app files and retry. Nothing was broadcast.
HI: ब्रॉडकास्ट उपलब्ध नहीं: इस बंडल में op-34 सीरियलाइज़र लोड नहीं है (tx.js/tx-send.js)। ऊपर पूर्वावलोकन सटीक है — ऐप फ़ाइलें पुनः लोड करें और पुनः प्रयास करें। कुछ ब्रॉडकास्ट नहीं हुआ।

### createworker.draft_a_worker_op_34_preview_is_live_review_q
EN: Draft a worker (op %(op)s). Preview is live; review quotes the live fee, then Sign & Send broadcasts op %(op)s directly — workers are created by direct op, not by proposal.
HI: वर्कर का मसौदा तैयार करें (op %(op)s)। प्रीव्यू लाइव है; समीक्षा में लाइव शुल्क बताया जाता है, फिर साइन और भेजें op %(op)s को सीधे प्रसारित करता है — वर्कर प्रस्ताव से नहीं, सीधे op से बनते हैं।

### createworker.pay_denom_note
EN: Daily pay is denominated in the core asset (%(sym)s, precision %(prec)s); the fee is quoted live at review time via get_required_fees.
HI: दैनिक वेतन कोर एसेट (%(sym)s, परिशुद्धता %(prec)s) में अंकित है; शुल्क समीक्षा समय पर get_required_fees से लाइव बताया जाता है।

### createworker.publishing_a_worker_requires_a_lifeti
EN: Publishing a worker requires a lifetime-member account — basic accounts cannot pay this fee. The owner below must already be upgraded.
HI: वर्कर प्रकाशन के लिए लाइफ़टाइम-सदस्य खाता आवश्यक है — बुनियादी खाते यह शुल्क नहीं दे सकते। नीचे मालिक पहले से अपग्रेडेड होना चाहिए।

### credit.lend_assets_at_a_fee_rate_a_borrower_accepts
EN: Lend assets at a fee rate. A borrower accepts an offer and a credit deal appears. Rates are percent at denom 1,000,000 — 0.1% stores 1000 units.
HI: एसेट शुल्क दर पर उधार दें। उधारकर्ता प्रस्ताव स्वीकार करता है और क्रेडिट डील बनती है। दरें 1,000,000 हर में प्रतिशत हैं — 0.1% अर्थात् 1000 इकाई संग्रहीत।

### help.topic_about-making_body
EN: # Making of this wallet
What follows is the original build story: every prompt that created this wallet, from "acquire bitshares-ui" on 26 September 2026 to the issue-1 fix on 3 October, with the builders' replies — preserved unedited.
It records the decisions this wallet stands on: walking away from another React uplift after issue #3583 and its thousand-hour trap, so this wallet depends on nothing with a release cycle; signing every transaction locally like the old wallet instead of outsourcing it; three themes with the classic look as default; numbers in human terms, never raw chain integers; phone-first layouts from the first slice; and fees read from the live chain, never estimated. Read it as history: this is how the wallet got built.
# The full dialog archive
The complete exchange-by-exchange record lives on the About page (#/about). Expand the "Full build dialog" section there to browse all exchanges, filter by keyword, or deep-link to a specific exchange with ?dialog=N.
HI: # इस वॉलेट का निर्माण
आगे मूल निर्माण कथा दी गई है: इस वॉलेट को बनाने वाला हर प्रॉम्प्ट, 26 सितंबर 2026 को “acquire bitshares-ui” से लेकर 3 अक्टूबर के issue-1 सुधार तक, निर्माताओं के उत्तरों सहित — बिना किसी बदलाव के सुरक्षित।
यह उन निर्णयों को दर्ज करती है जिन पर यह वॉलेट खड़ा है: issue #3583 और उसके हज़ार-घंटे के जाल से बाहर निकलकर एक और React उन्नयन छोड़ना, ताकि यह वॉलेट किसी रिलीज़-साइकल वाली चीज़ पर निर्भर न रहे; पुराने वॉलेट की तरह हर लेनदेन स्वयं स्थानीय रूप से हस्ताक्षरित करना, उसे बाहर सौंपने के बजाय; तीन थीम, जिनमें क्लासिक रूप मानक है; संख्याएँ मानव पदों में, कभी कच्चे चेन पूर्णांक नहीं; पहली स्लाइस से ही फ़ोन-प्रथम लेआउट; और शुल्क लाइव चेन से पढ़े गए, कभी अनुमानित नहीं। इसे इतिहास की तरह पढ़ें: वॉलेट इसी तरह बना।
# पूर्ण संवाद संग्रह
पूरा एक्सचेंज-दर-एक्सचेंज रिकॉर्ड परिचय पेज (#/about) पर है। सभी एक्सचेंज देखने, कीवर्ड से छानने, या किसी एक्सचेंज तक गहरा लिंक बनाने हेतु वहाँ “पूर्ण बिल्ड संवाद” अनुभाग फैलाएँ — ?dialog=N के साथ।

### help.topic_accounts-general_body
EN: # One name, one account
On this chain you register a human-readable account name first, then use it everywhere instead of pasting raw addresses.
Owning the name and being able to spend its funds are separate rights, which is what makes shared and corporate accounts possible — see Permissions.
# What lives on an account
Balances across every asset you hold, your open exchange orders, and your full transaction history all hang off the account.
# In this wallet
Open any account overview to see its balances, open orders, and history with no login — reads are public on a public chain.
Only spending needs your keys: cancelling someone else's order is refused, and your own cancels ask you to unlock first.
HI: # एक नाम, एक खाता
इस चेन पर आप पहले मानव-पठनीय खाता नाम पंजीकृत करते हैं, फिर कच्चे पते चिपकाने के बजाय हर जगह उसी का प्रयोग करते हैं।
नाम का स्वामित्व और उसकी धनराशि खर्च करने का अधिकार पृथक हैं, जिससे साझा व कॉर्पोरेट खाते संभव होते हैं — अनुमतियाँ देखें।
# खाते पर क्या रहता है
आपके धारित प्रत्येक एसेट के बैलेंस, आपके खुले एक्सचेंज ऑर्डर और आपका पूर्ण लेनदेन इतिहास सब खाते से जुड़े हैं।
# इस वॉलेट में
बिना लॉगिन किसी भी खाता अवलोकन में उसके बैलेंस, खुले ऑर्डर व हिस्ट्री देखें — सार्वजनिक चेन पर पठन सार्वजनिक है।
केवल खर्च हेतु आपकी कुंजियाँ चाहिए: किसी अन्य के ऑर्डर रद्द करना अस्वीकृत होता है, और आपके स्वयं के रद्द करने पर पहले अनलॉक माँगा जाता है।

### help.topic_accounts-membership_body
EN: # Three tiers
Every account starts as a regular non-member. Upgrading buys lifetime status; an annual subscription sits in between for smaller budgets.
Upgrading is an on-chain action with a fee from the published fee schedule — the confirm dialog shows the exact price before you sign.
# Why go lifetime
Lifetime members earn cashback on every transaction fee they pay, plus referral income from users they bring to the network.
# Where fee money goes
Each fee you pay is split: the network takes its cut, the lifetime member who referred you takes theirs, and the registrar divides the remainder with its affiliate program.
# Pending and vesting fees
Referral splits settle once per maintenance interval, not instantly. Large fees, such as membership upgrades, vest over the committee-defined period.
HI: # तीन स्तर
प्रत्येक खाता नियमित गैर-सदस्य शुरू होता है। अपग्रेड से आजीवन स्थिति मिलती है; छोटे बजट हेतु बीच में वार्षिक सदस्यता है।
अपग्रेड प्रकाशित शुल्क अनुसूची से शुल्क सहित ऑन-चेन कार्रवाई है — पुष्टि संवाद हस्ताक्षर से पहले सटीक मूल्य दिखाता है।
# आजीवन क्यों बनें
आजीवन सदस्य प्रत्येक चुकाए शुल्क पर कैशबैक, साथ ही लाए गए उपयोगकर्ताओं से रेफ़रल आय कमाते हैं।
# शुल्क धन कहाँ जाता है
आपका प्रत्येक शुल्क बँटता है: नेटवर्क अपना कट लेता है, आपको रेफ़र करने वाला आजीवन सदस्य अपना लेता है, और रजिस्ट्रार शेष अपने सहबद्ध कार्यक्रम से बाँटता है।
# लंबित व वेस्टिंग शुल्क
रेफ़रल बँटवारे प्रति रखरखाव अंतराल सेटल होते हैं, तुरंत नहीं। सदस्यता अपग्रेड जैसे बड़े शुल्क कमेटी-परिभाषित अवधि में वेस्ट होते हैं।

### help.topic_accounts-permissions_body
EN: # Two locks: active and owner
Active permission controls the money — spending, trading, transferring. Owner permission controls the account itself and can overwrite keys and settings.
Both are edited in your account's Permissions tab as authorities plus a threshold: the summed weight of the signers must beat the threshold for a transaction to count.
# Authorities, weights, thresholds
An authority names one or more accounts (or keys), each with a weight. Signatures add up their weights; cross the threshold and the action is authorized.
This one mechanism expresses everything from a single key to corporate hierarchies.
# Example: shared funds, any two of four
Give four partners weight 33 each with threshold 51: any two together pass, no single one can move funds alone.
# Example: one stays in charge
Give the lead 49 and each friend a smaller slice with threshold 51: the lead plus any one friend can act, or all friends together — theft by one friend alone is impossible.
# The memo key
The memo key only receives encrypted memos — it can never spend. Because it carries no spending power, you may share its private key with a reader (auditor, accountant) for read-only memo access without risking funds.
HI: # दो ताले: एक्टिव व ओनर
एक्टिव अनुमति धन नियंत्रित करती है — खर्च, व्यापार, ट्रांसफर। ओनर अनुमति खाता स्वयं नियंत्रित करती है और कुंजियाँ व सेटिंग अधिलेखित कर सकती है।
दोनों आपके खाते के अनुमति टैब में अथॉरिटी व सीमा के रूप में संपादित होती हैं: हस्ताक्षरकर्ताओं के भारों का योग लेनदेन गिनती हेतु सीमा पार करना चाहिए।
# अथॉरिटी, भार, सीमाएँ
अथॉरिटी एक या अधिक खातों (या कुंजियों) को नाम देती है, प्रत्येक भार सहित। हस्ताक्षर उनके भार जोड़ते हैं; सीमा पार तो कार्रवाई प्राधिकृत।
यह एक तंत्र एकल कुंजी से कॉर्पोरेट पदानुक्रम तक सब व्यक्त करता है।
# उदाहरण: साझा धन, चार में से कोई दो
चार भागीदारों को सीमा 51 सहित प्रत्येक को भार 33 दें: कोई दो मिलकर पार करते हैं, कोई एक अकेले धन नहीं हिला सकता।
# उदाहरण: एक प्रभारी बना रहे
प्रमुख को 49 और प्रत्येक मित्र को छोटा भाग सीमा 51 सहित दें: प्रमुख व कोई एक मित्र कार्य कर सकते हैं, या सभी मित्र मिलकर — एक मित्र अकेले चोरी असंभव है।
# मेमो कुंजी
मेमो कुंजी केवल एन्क्रिप्टेड मेमो प्राप्त करती है — कभी खर्च नहीं कर सकती। खर्च शक्ति न होने से आप धन जोखिम बिना केवल-पठन मेमो पहुँच हेतु इसकी निजी कुंजी पाठक (लेखापरीक्षक, मुनीम) से साझा कर सकते हैं।

### help.topic_accounts-permissions_title
EN: Permissions

### help.topic_accounts-proposed_body
EN: # Suggest what you cannot sign
A proposal submits a transaction for someone else's approval: you suggest an action on an account you do not control, and the controlling parties approve or ignore it.
The classic case is a shared multi-signature account — one party proposes a transfer, the others approve until the authority threshold is met, and then it executes.
# They expire on their own
Every proposal carries an expiry date. Past that date it disappears by itself, so a stale suggestion cannot surprise anyone months later.
# Treat surprises as hostile
An unexpected proposal on your account deserves suspicion, not curiosity — even if the proposer's name looks familiar.
When in doubt, ignore it and contact the supposed counterparty through a channel you already trust. Never approve what you do not understand.
# In this wallet
Review pending proposals and approve or reject them from the proposals screens; the confirm dialog shows exactly what the proposal would do before you sign.
HI: # वह सुझाएँ जिस पर आप हस्ताक्षर नहीं कर सकते
प्रस्ताव किसी अन्य के अनुमोदन हेतु लेनदेन प्रस्तुत करता है: आप उस खाते पर कार्रवाई सुझाते हैं जिसे आप नियंत्रित नहीं करते, और नियंत्रक पक्ष अनुमोदन करते हैं या अनदेखा करते हैं।
क्लासिक मामला साझा मल्टी-सिग्नेचर खाता है — एक पक्ष ट्रांसफर प्रस्तावित करता है, अन्य अथॉरिटी सीमा पूरी होने तक अनुमोदन करते हैं, फिर वह निष्पादित होता है।
# वे स्वयं समाप्त होते हैं
प्रत्येक प्रस्ताव समाप्ति दिनांक रखता है। उस दिनांक के बाद वह स्वयं गायब हो जाता है, इसलिए पुराना सुझाव महीनों बाद किसी को चौंका नहीं सकता।
# आश्चर्यों को शत्रुतापूर्ण मानें
आपके खाते पर अप्रत्याशित प्रस्ताव संदेह योग्य है, जिज्ञासा नहीं — भले प्रस्तावक का नाम परिचित लगे।
संदेह हो तो अनदेखा करें और कथित समकक्ष से पहले से विश्वसनीय माध्यम से संपर्क करें। जो न समझें उसे कभी अनुमोदन न दें।
# इस वॉलेट में
लंबित प्रस्तावों की समीक्षा करें और प्रस्ताव स्क्रीनों से अनुमोदन या अस्वीकृति दें; पुष्टि संवाद हस्ताक्षर से पहले ठीक दिखाता है कि प्रस्ताव क्या करेगा।

HI: प्रस्तावित लेनदेन

### help.topic_airdrop_body
EN: # One plan, many recipients
Airdrops distribute an asset to a list of accounts in a single planned operation instead of hundreds of manual transfers.
Build the recipient list, preview totals, confirm once — the chain fans the payments out.
# Mind the dust
Tiny outputs can cost more in fees than they deliver. Preview per-recipient net amounts and drop dust lines before signing.
HI: # एक योजना, अनेक प्राप्तकर्ता
एयरड्रॉप सैकड़ों हाथ ट्रांसफर के बजाय एकल नियोजित ऑपरेशन में खातों की सूची को एसेट वितरित करते हैं।
प्राप्तकर्ता सूची बनाएँ, योग पूर्वावलोकन करें, एक बार पुष्टि करें — चेन भुगतान फैला देती है।
# धूल ध्यान रखें
छोटे निर्गत शुल्क में जितना देते हैं उससे अधिक लागत कर सकते हैं। हस्ताक्षर से पहले प्रति-प्राप्तकर्ता शुद्ध राशि पूर्वावलोकन करें और धूल पंक्तियाँ हटाएँ।

### help.topic_alerts_body
EN: # Never watch a screen again
Price alerts watch markets while you live your life: set a price, pick above or below, get notified when the market crosses it.
Notifications stay off by default — each rule opts in explicitly, and rules die with one tap.
# Rules that respect you
Alerts evaluate on ticker refreshes, never on your keystrokes. No account needed to create one; signing is never involved — alerts only read.
HI: # स्क्रीन देखना फिर कभी नहीं
मूल्य चेतावनी आपके जीते जी मार्केट देखती हैं: मूल्य निर्धारित करें, ऊपर या नीचे चुनें, मार्केट पार करे तो सूचित पाएँ।
सूचनाएँ डिफ़ॉल्ट बंद रहती हैं — प्रत्येक नियम स्पष्टतः ऑप्ट-इन करता है, और नियम एक टैप से मरते हैं।
# सम्मान करने वाले नियम
चेतावनी टिकर ताज़गी पर मूल्यांकित होती हैं, आपकी कुंजी दबाने पर कभी नहीं। बनाने हेतु कोई खाता आवश्यक नहीं; हस्ताक्षर कभी शामिल नहीं — चेतावनी केवल पढ़ती हैं।

### help.topic_api-lab_body
EN: # A 29-call node prober
API Lab catalogs the calls this wallet actually uses — account and asset lookups, market data, fees, block reads — with forms for parameters and raw JSON results.
# Reads run free, broadcasts cost
Read-only calls execute against the connected node immediately. Anything that would broadcast names its fee before signing, same as every other desk.
# When a call fails
Failures name the cause (offline node, history-less node, bad parameter) and link back to Settings. Switch nodes from the node table and re-run.
HI: # 29-कॉल नोड जाँचक
API लैब उन कॉलों की सूची देता है जो यह वॉलेट वास्तव में प्रयोग करता है — खाता व एसेट खोज, मार्केट डेटा, शुल्क, ब्लॉक पठन — पैरामीटर फ़ॉर्म व कच्चे JSON परिणामों सहित।
# पठन निःशुल्क चलते हैं, प्रसारण लागत करता है
केवल-पठन कॉल जुड़े नोड पर तत्काल निष्पादित होती हैं। जो भी प्रसारित करे वह हर अन्य डेस्क की तरह हस्ताक्षर से पहले अपना शुल्क नाम देती है।
# कॉल विफल हो तो
विफलताएँ कारण नाम देती हैं (ऑफ़लाइन नोड, हिस्ट्रीहीन नोड, गलत पैरामीटर) और सेटिंग्स से जोड़ती हैं। नोड तालिका से नोड बदलें और पुनः चलाएँ।
